        "contents": "import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\nimport { hasEnvVars } from \"../utils\";\n\nexport async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  // If the env vars are not set, skip proxy check.         "contents": "import { type EmailOtpType } from \"@supabase/supabase-js\";\nimport { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\n\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);\n  const token_hash = searchParams.get(\"token_hash\");\n  const type = searchParams.get(\"type\") as EmailOtpType | null;\n  const next = searchParams.get(\"next\") ?? \"/\";\n\n  if (token_hash &amp;&amp; type) {\n    const supabase = await createClient();\n\n    const { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n      type,\n      token_hash,\n    });\n    if (!error) {\n      // redirect user to specified redirect URL or root of app\n      redirect(next);\n    } else {\n      // redirect the user to an error page with some instructions\n      redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=${error?.message}&#96;);\n    }\n  }\n\n  // redirect the user to an error page with some instructions\n  redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=No token hash or type&#96;);\n}",

        "contents": "import { cookies } from \"next/headers\";\n\n/**\n * Especially important if using Fluid compute: Don't put this client in a\n * global variable.         "contents": "1. **RLS Policies** (row-level access control):\n\n   - Users can only read/update their own profile (limited fields)\n   - Only admins can create/delete profiles and manage teams\n   - Team data viewable by team members\n\n2. **Database Constraints**:\n\n   - Domain constraint ensures only valid CZU domains in profiles\n   - Unique constraints on work_email, user_id\n\n### Next.js (Application Layer)\n\n1. **Middleware Verification**:\n\n   - Queries &#96;profiles&#96; table for linked user_id\n   - Checks &#96;removed_access&#96; is null for active access\n   - Enforces role-based route protection\n   - Real-time verification (instant access revocation)\n\n2. **Domain Validation** (in server actions):\n\n   - Client-side validation for UX (immediate feedback)\n   - Server-side validation before sending OTP\n   - Validates email format and CZU domain\n\n3. **Access Management** (in server actions):\n\n   - Admin sets &#96;removed_access&#96; timestamp and &#96;removed_access_by&#96; profile\n   - Immediate effect on next request\n   - Audit trail of who revoked access and when\n\n## Authentication Flow Details\n\n### Step 1: Google Login\n\nUser clicks Google login button, Supabase handles OAuth flow.\n\n### Step 2: Work Email Input with Domain Validation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Validate domain before sending OTP\nif (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(workEmail)) {\n  throw new Error('Email must be @studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz');\n}\n\n// Send OTP to work email (only after domain validation passes)\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  options: { shouldCreateUser: false }\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 3: OTP Verification and Profile Linking\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// After user enters OTP, verify it\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  token: otpCode,\n  type: 'email'\n});\n\n// Check if profile exists for this work email\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .select('id')\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) {\n  // No profile exists - redirect to pending approval",

        "contents": "### ORM Best Practices\n\n- Use type-safe ORMs (Drizzle, Prisma, etc.)\n- Define schemas with proper relationships and constraints\n- Infer types from schema definitions\n- Write repository-style helpers to isolate queries\n- Implement proper migrations\n\n### Data Access Patterns\n\n- Keep database queries in dedicated modules\n- Avoid N+1 queries; use joins and CTEs\n- Implement pagination for list endpoints\n- Use select projections to limit payload size\n\n## Authentication &amp; Authorization\n\n- Implement server-side auth checks\n- Never trust client-side auth flags\n- Use middleware for route protection\n- Store user data securely with proper encryption\n\n## Testing Strategy\n\n### Unit Testing (Vitest)\n\n- **Never mock internal code** - only mock external dependencies\n- Use MSW for API mocking when needed\n- Test utilities, repositories, and business logic\n- Mock external services (APIs, databases, file systems)\n\n### Component Testing (React Testing Library)\n\n- Test interactive components with proper accessibility\n- Ensure loading and error states are covered\n- Test user interactions and state changes\n- Use data-testid sparingly; prefer semantic queries\n\n### Integration Testing\n\n- Test API endpoints with real database connections\n- Use test databases with proper cleanup\n- Test authentication flows end-to-end\n- Mock external services consistently\n\n### Test Structure\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Example test structure\ndescribe(\"Feature\", () =&gt; {\n  describe(\"when condition\", () =&gt; {\n    it(\"should expected behavior\", async () =&gt; {\n      // Arrange\n      // Act\n      // Assert\n    });\n  });\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Error Handling &amp; Observability\n\n- Implement early returns on invalid input (fail fast)\n- Use typed error codes and messages\n- Log server-side with contextual metadata\n- Never expose stack traces to clients\n- Provide user-friendly error messages\n\n## Security Best Practices\n\n- Validate all inputs at boundaries\n- Use environment variables for sensitive data (server-only)\n- Implement proper CORS policies\n- Sanitize user inputs\n- Use HTTPS in production\n- Implement rate limiting where appropriate",

        "contents": "| Access without verified work email          | Middleware checks &#96;profiles.user_id&#96; is linked   |\n\n| Unverified/fake work email                  | OTP verification required before linking            |\n\n| Non-CZU domain emails                       | Domain validation (client + server + DB constraint) |\n\n| Access without pre-created profile          | Profile must exist before linking (admin creates profiles)           |\n\n| Revoked access                              | Middleware checks &#96;profiles.removed_access IS NULL&#96;           |\n\n### Profile Verification (Next.js Middleware)\n\nAll verification logic lives in Next.js middleware, not in Supabase:\n\n- **Profile Linked**: Check &#96;profiles.user_id&#96; matches current auth.user.id\n- **Access Active**: Check &#96;profiles.removed_access IS NULL&#96;\n- **User Role**: Read &#96;profiles.role&#96; column (student, team_leader, coach, admin)\n\nThis approach:\n\n- Keeps all business logic in Next.js (single source of truth)\n- Allows real-time updates (e.g., instant access revocation)\n- Admin pre-creates profiles, users link via work email verification\n- Supabase only handles auth + data storage (no custom hooks or functions)\n\n## Development &amp; Testing with Supabase MCP\n\nThe project has a &#96;supabase/&#96; directory with Supabase MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration available for:\n\n1. **Running migrations**: Apply and test database schema changes locally\n2. **Querying tables**: Verify RLS policies and data integrity\n3. **Debugging auth flow**: Inspect user sessions and profile data\n4. **Testing verification logic**: Query profiles and teams tables\n\n**Useful MCP commands for development:**\n\n- Verify RLS policies by querying as different user roles\n- Seed test data into profiles and teams tables\n- Inspect auth.users and profiles tables\n- Test profile linking and access revocation queries\n\n## Files to DELETE (Password-based auth leftovers)\n\nThese files are for email+password authentication and are **not needed** with Google OAuth:\n\n| File | Reason |\n\n|------|--------|\n\n| &#96;components/login-form.tsx&#96; | Replaced by Google login button |",

        "contents": "if (!profile) {\n  // No profile exists - redirect to pending approval\n  redirect('/auth/pending-approval');\n}\n\n// Link profile to current user\nconst { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\nawait supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .update({ \n    user_id: user.id,\n    picture: user.user_metadata.avatar_url  // Default to Google picture\n  })\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 4: Middleware Validation\n\nQuery database for profile linked to current auth.user and check &#96;removed_access IS NULL&#96; on every request to protected routes.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Middleware check\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .select('id, role, removed_access')\n  .eq('user_id', user.id)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) redirect('/auth/verify-work-email');\nif (profile.removed_access) redirect('/auth/access-revoked');\n// User has active access, continue...\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Estimated Complexity\n\n| Task | Complexity | Lines of Code |\n\n|------|------------|---------------|\n\n| Delete old auth files | Trivial | -500 lines |\n\n| Security lockdown config | Trivial | ~20 lines TOML |\n\n| Database migration | Low | ~50 lines SQL (profiles, teams, indexes) |\n\n| Constants + validation | Trivial | ~25 lines |\n\n| Server actions (business logic) | Medium | ~80 lines |\n\n| Middleware update | Medium | ~50 lines (includes DB queries) |\n\n| Google login page | Low | ~30 lines |\n\n| Work email form + linking | Medium | ~120 lines |\n\n| Admin UI (profiles + teams) | Medium | ~150 lines |\n\n**Total new code**: ~525 lines (vs ~500 lines deleted)\n\n## Separation of Concerns\n\n### Supabase (Auth + Storage Only)\n\n- **Authentication**: Google OAuth flow, session management, OTP emails\n- **Database**: Store profiles, teams data with RLS for row-level access control\n- **No business logic**: No custom hooks, no stored procedures, no triggers for business rules\n\n### Next.js (All Business Logic)\n\n- **Middleware**: Profile verification, access checks, role-based routing\n- **Server Actions**: Profile linking, access revocation, team management\n- **Validation**: Domain validation, input sanitization, business rules",

        "contents": "'studenti.czu.cz',\n  'pef.czu.cz',\n] as const;\n\nexport const isValidWorkEmailDomain = (email: string): boolean =&gt; {\n  const domain = email.split('@')[1]?.toLowerCase();\n  return ALLOWED_WORK_EMAIL_DOMAINS.includes(domain as any);\n};\n\n// Profile roles (matches database enum)\nexport const PROFILE_ROLES = ['student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin'] as const;\nexport type ProfileRole = typeof PROFILE_ROLES[number];\n\n// Role hierarchy for permission checks\nexport const ROLE_HIERARCHY: Record&lt;ProfileRole, number&gt; = {\n  student: 0,\n  team_leader: 1,\n  coach: 2,\n  admin: 3,\n} as const;\n\nexport const hasMinimumRole = (userRole: ProfileRole, requiredRole: ProfileRole): boolean =&gt; {\n  return ROLE_HIERARCHY[userRole] &gt;= ROLE_HIERARCHY[requiredRole];\n};\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Supabase Configuration Changes\n\nUpdate [&#96;supabase/config.toml&#96;](supabase/config.toml):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth]\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking\nenable_anonymous_sign_ins = false   # Block anonymous access\n\n[auth.email]\nenable_signup = false               # Block direct email/password signup\nenable_confirmations = false        # We use OTP for work email, not signup confirmation\n\n[auth.external.google]\nenabled = true\nclient_id = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\"\nsecret = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Security Lockdown (Google OAuth Only)\n\n**Goal**: Users can ONLY authenticate via Google OAuth + work email verification. All other methods are blocked.\n\n### Blocked Scenarios\n\n| Attack Vector                               | How It's Blocked                                    |\n\n| ------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |\n\n| Direct email/password signup                | &#96;enable_signup = false&#96; in auth.email               |\n\n| Other OAuth providers (Apple, GitHub, etc.) | All providers disabled except Google                |\n\n| Anonymous access                            | &#96;enable_anonymous_sign_ins = false&#96;                 |\n\n| Access without verified work email          | Middleware checks &#96;profiles.user_id&#96; is linked   |\n\n| Unverified/fake work email                  | OTP verification required before linking            |",

        "contents": "\"use client\";\n\nimport { cn } from \"@/lib/utils\";\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/client\";\nimport { Button } from \"@/components/ui/button\";\nimport {\n  Card,\n  CardContent,\n  CardDescription,\n  CardHeader,\n  CardTitle,\n} from \"@/components/ui/card\";\nimport { Input } from \"@/components/ui/input\";\nimport { Label } from \"@/components/ui/label\";\nimport { useRouter } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { useState } from \"react\";\n\nexport function UpdatePasswordForm({\n  className,\n  ...props\n}: React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef&lt;\"div\"&gt;) {\n  const [password, setPassword] = useState(\"\");\n  const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n  const router = useRouter();\n\n  const handleForgotPassword = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    const supabase = createClient();\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    setError(null);\n\n    try {\n      const { error } = await supabase.auth.updateUser({ password });\n      if (error) throw error;\n      // Update this route to redirect to an authenticated route.         "contents": "## Architecture Overview\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid\nflowchart TD\n    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]\n        A[User clicks Google Login] --&gt; B[Google OAuth]\n        B --&gt; C[Redirect back with Google identity]\n        C --&gt; D{Profile linked to user?}\n        D --&gt;|No| E[Prompt for work email]\n        E --&gt; F{Domain is czu.cz?}\n        F --&gt;|No| G[Show domain error]\n        G --&gt; E\n        F --&gt;|Yes| H[Send OTP to work email]\n        H --&gt; I[User enters OTP]\n        I --&gt; J{Profile exists for work email?}\n        J --&gt;|No| K[Pending Approval Page]\n        J --&gt;|Yes| L[Link profile to user]\n        D --&gt;|Yes| M{Access revoked?}\n        L --&gt; M\n        M --&gt;|Yes| N[Show access revoked]\n        M --&gt;|No| O[Grant Full Access]\n    end\n\n    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]\n        P[Incoming Request] --&gt; Q[Middleware queries database]\n        Q --&gt; R{Profile linked to user?}\n        R --&gt;|No| S[Redirect to verify email]\n        R --&gt;|Yes| T{removed_access is null?}\n        T --&gt;|No| U[Show access revoked]\n        T --&gt;|Yes| V[Allow access]\n    end\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Validation Flow\n\n**Two-stage validation:**\n\n1. **Before OTP (Domain Check)**: Validate email ends with &#96;@studenti.czu.cz&#96; or &#96;@pef.czu.cz&#96;\n\n   - Client-side: Immediate feedback\n   - Server-side: Validated before &#96;signInWithOtp&#96; is called\n\n2. **After OTP (Profile Linking)**: Check if a profile exists for the verified work email\n\n   - If profile exists with that work_email → link profile to auth.user\n   - If no profile exists → show \"Pending Approval\" (admin must create profile first)\n   - Checked on every request via middleware\n\n## Database Schema (Supabase Migrations)\n\nThree tables with RLS policies managed entirely in Supabase:\n\n1. **&#96;auth.users&#96;** - Supabase-managed authentication (Google OAuth)\n2. **&#96;profiles&#96;** - User profile data with role and team membership\n3. **&#96;teams&#96;** - Team information\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Role enum for profiles\ncreate type public.profile_role as enum ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin');\n\n-- Teams table\ncreate table public.teams (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  name text not null,",

        "contents": "import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\nimport { hasEnvVars } from \"../utils\";\n\nexport async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  // If the env vars are not set, skip proxy check. You can remove this\n  // once you setup the project.\n  if (!hasEnvVars) {\n    return supabaseResponse;\n  }\n\n  // With Fluid compute, don't put this client in a global environment\n  // variable. Always create a new one on each request.\n  const supabase = createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return request.cookies.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt;\n            request.cookies.set(name, value),\n          );\n          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n            request,\n          });\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt;\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options),\n          );\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n\n  // Do not run code between createServerClient and\n  // supabase.auth.getClaims(). A simple mistake could make it very hard to debug\n  // issues with users being randomly logged out.\n\n  // IMPORTANT: If you remove getClaims() and you use server-side rendering\n  // with the Supabase client, your users may be randomly logged out.\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n  const user = data?.claims;\n\n  // Public routes that don't require authentication\n  const publicRoutes = ['/', '/auth/login', '/auth/error', '/auth/pending-approval', '/auth/access-revoked', '/auth/verify-work-email'];\n  const isPublicRoute = publicRoutes.includes(request.nextUrl.pathname) || \n    request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith('/auth/');\n  \n  // Admin routes require admin role check (handled in admin layout)\n  const isAdminRoute = request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith('/admin/');\n\n  // If no user and not a public route, redirect to login\n  if (!user &amp;&amp; !isPublicRoute) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/login\";\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "## Architecture Overview\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid\nflowchart TD\n    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]\n        A[User clicks Google Login] --&gt; B[Google OAuth]\n        B --&gt; C[Redirect back with Google identity]\n        C --&gt; D{Profile linked to user?}\n        D --&gt;|No| E[Prompt for work email]\n        E --&gt; F{Domain is czu.cz?}\n        F --&gt;|No| G[Show domain error]\n        G --&gt; E\n        F --&gt;|Yes| H[Send OTP to work email]\n        H --&gt; I[User enters OTP]\n        I --&gt; J{Profile exists for work email?}\n        J --&gt;|No| K[Pending Approval Page]\n        J --&gt;|Yes| L[Link profile to user]\n        D --&gt;|Yes| M{Access revoked?}\n        L --&gt; M\n        M --&gt;|Yes| N[Show access revoked]\n        M --&gt;|No| O[Grant Full Access]\n    end\n\n    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]\n        P[Incoming Request] --&gt; Q[Middleware queries database]\n        Q --&gt; R{Profile linked to user?}\n        R --&gt;|No| S[Redirect to verify email]\n        R --&gt;|Yes| T{removed_access is null?}\n        T --&gt;|No| U[Show access revoked]\n        T --&gt;|Yes| V[Allow access]\n    end\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Validation Flow\n\n**Two-stage validation:**\n\n1. **Before OTP (Domain Check)**: Validate email ends with &#96;@studenti.czu.cz&#96; or &#96;@pef.czu.cz&#96;\n\n   - Client-side: Immediate feedback\n   - Server-side: Validated before &#96;signInWithOtp&#96; is called\n\n2. **After OTP (Profile Linking)**: Check if a profile exists for the verified work email\n\n   - If profile exists with that work_email → link profile to auth.user\n   - If no profile exists → show \"Pending Approval\" (admin must create profile first)\n   - Checked on every request via middleware\n\n## Database Schema (Supabase Migrations)\n\nThree tables with RLS policies managed entirely in Supabase:\n\n1. **&#96;auth.users&#96;** - Supabase-managed authentication (Google OAuth)\n2. **&#96;profiles&#96;** - User profile data with role and team membership\n3. **&#96;teams&#96;** - Team information\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Role enum for profiles\ncreate type public.profile_role as enum ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin');\n\n-- Teams table\ncreate table public.teams (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  name text not null,",

        "contents": "| Access without verified work email          | Middleware checks &#96;profiles.user_id&#96; is linked   |\n\n| Unverified/fake work email                  | OTP verification required before linking            |\n\n| Non-CZU domain emails                       | Domain validation (client + server + DB constraint) |\n\n| Access without pre-created profile          | Profile must exist before linking (admin creates profiles)           |\n\n| Revoked access                              | Middleware checks &#96;profiles.removed_access IS NULL&#96;           |\n\n### Profile Verification (Next.js Middleware)\n\nAll verification logic lives in Next.js middleware, not in Supabase:\n\n- **Profile Linked**: Check &#96;profiles.user_id&#96; matches current auth.user.id\n- **Access Active**: Check &#96;profiles.removed_access IS NULL&#96;\n- **User Role**: Read &#96;profiles.role&#96; column (student, team_leader, coach, admin)\n\nThis approach:\n\n- Keeps all business logic in Next.js (single source of truth)\n- Allows real-time updates (e.g., instant access revocation)\n- Admin pre-creates profiles, users link via work email verification\n- Supabase only handles auth + data storage (no custom hooks or functions)\n\n## Development &amp; Testing with Supabase MCP\n\nThe project has a &#96;supabase/&#96; directory with Supabase MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration available for:\n\n1. **Running migrations**: Apply and test database schema changes locally\n2. **Querying tables**: Verify RLS policies and data integrity\n3. **Debugging auth flow**: Inspect user sessions and profile data\n4. **Testing verification logic**: Query profiles and teams tables\n\n**Useful MCP commands for development:**\n\n- Verify RLS policies by querying as different user roles\n- Seed test data into profiles and teams tables\n- Inspect auth.users and profiles tables\n- Test profile linking and access revocation queries\n\n## Files to DELETE (Password-based auth leftovers)\n\nThese files are for email+password authentication and are **not needed** with Google OAuth:\n\n| File | Reason |\n\n|------|--------|\n\n| &#96;components/login-form.tsx&#96; | Replaced by Google login button |",

        "contents": "'studenti.czu.cz',\n  'pef.czu.cz',\n] as const;\n\nexport const isValidWorkEmailDomain = (email: string): boolean =&gt; {\n  const domain = email.split('@')[1]?.toLowerCase();\n  return ALLOWED_WORK_EMAIL_DOMAINS.includes(domain as any);\n};\n\n// Profile roles (matches database enum)\nexport const PROFILE_ROLES = ['student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin'] as const;\nexport type ProfileRole = typeof PROFILE_ROLES[number];\n\n// Role hierarchy for permission checks\nexport const ROLE_HIERARCHY: Record&lt;ProfileRole, number&gt; = {\n  student: 0,\n  team_leader: 1,\n  coach: 2,\n  admin: 3,\n} as const;\n\nexport const hasMinimumRole = (userRole: ProfileRole, requiredRole: ProfileRole): boolean =&gt; {\n  return ROLE_HIERARCHY[userRole] &gt;= ROLE_HIERARCHY[requiredRole];\n};\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Supabase Configuration Changes\n\nUpdate [&#96;supabase/config.toml&#96;](supabase/config.toml):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth]\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking\nenable_anonymous_sign_ins = false   # Block anonymous access\n\n[auth.email]\nenable_signup = false               # Block direct email/password signup\nenable_confirmations = false        # We use OTP for work email, not signup confirmation\n\n[auth.external.google]\nenabled = true\nclient_id = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\"\nsecret = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Security Lockdown (Google OAuth Only)\n\n**Goal**: Users can ONLY authenticate via Google OAuth + work email verification. All other methods are blocked.\n\n### Blocked Scenarios\n\n| Attack Vector                               | How It's Blocked                                    |\n\n| ------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |\n\n| Direct email/password signup                | &#96;enable_signup = false&#96; in auth.email               |\n\n| Other OAuth providers (Apple, GitHub, etc.) | All providers disabled except Google                |\n\n| Anonymous access                            | &#96;enable_anonymous_sign_ins = false&#96;                 |\n\n| Access without verified work email          | Middleware checks &#96;profiles.user_id&#96; is linked   |\n\n| Unverified/fake work email                  | OTP verification required before linking            |",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 223
          },
          {
            "text": "## Security Lockdown (Google OAuth Only)",
            "lineNumber": 224
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 225
          },
          {
            "text": "**Goal**: Users can ONLY authenticate via Google OAuth + work email verification. All other methods are blocked.",
            "lineNumber": 226
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 227
          },
          {
            "text": "### Blocked Scenarios",
            "lineNumber": 228
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 229
          },
          {
            "text": "| Attack Vector                               | How It's Blocked                                    |",
            "lineNumber": 230
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 231
          },
          {
            "text": "| ------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |",
            "lineNumber": 232
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 233
          },
          {
            "text": "| Direct email/password signup                | &#96;enable_signup = false&#96; in auth.email               |",
            "lineNumber": 234
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 235
          },
          {
            "text": "| Other OAuth providers (Apple, GitHub, etc.) | All providers disabled except Google                |",
            "lineNumber": 236
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 237
          },
          {
            "text": "| Anonymous access                            | &#96;enable_anonymous_sign_ins = false&#96;                 |",
            "lineNumber": 238
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 239
          },
          {
            "text": "| Access without verified work email          | Middleware checks &#96;profiles.user_id&#96; is linked   |",
            "lineNumber": 240
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 241
          },
          {
            "text": "| Unverified/fake work email                  | OTP verification required before linking            |",
            "lineNumber": 242
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.31824609637260437
    },

        "contents": "---\nname: Work Email Auth System\noverview: Build a robust authentication system using Supabase with Google OAuth, work email verification (@studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz), profile linking, team management, and role-based permissions (student, team_leader, coach, admin).\ntodos:\n  - id: cleanup-old-auth\n    content: Delete unused password-based auth files (8 files)\n    status: pending\n  - id: security-lockdown\n    content: Lock down Supabase to only allow Google OAuth (disable email signup, other providers)\n    status: pending\n  - id: db-schema\n    content: Create Supabase migration for profiles and teams tables with RLS\n    status: pending\n  - id: profile-verification\n    content: Implement database-based profile verification (no JWT claims)\n    status: pending\n  - id: supabase-config\n    content: Update supabase/config.toml (manual_linking, Google OAuth, security settings)\n    status: pending\n  - id: auth-constants\n    content: Create lib/constants/auth.ts with domain validation and role constants\n    status: pending\n  - id: server-actions\n    content: Create lib/actions/auth.ts with profile linking, verification, access management\n    status: pending\n  - id: middleware-update\n    content: Update proxy.ts to query profiles table for verified user and access status\n    status: pending\n  - id: google-login\n    content: Create Google login button and rewrite login page\n    status: pending\n  - id: verify-email-flow\n    content: Create work email verification page with OTP and identity linking\n    status: pending\n  - id: admin-ui\n    content: Create admin pages for managing profiles and teams\n    status: pending\n---\n\n# Work Email Authentication System\n\n## Architecture Overview\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid\nflowchart TD\n    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]\n        ",

        "contents": "if (!profile) {\n  // No profile exists - redirect to pending approval\n  redirect('/auth/pending-approval');\n}\n\n// Link profile to current user\nconst { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\nawait supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .update({ \n    user_id: user.id,\n    picture: user.user_metadata.avatar_url  // Default to Google picture\n  })\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 4: Middleware Validation\n\nQuery database for profile linked to current auth.user and check &#96;removed_access IS NULL&#96; on every request to protected routes.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Middleware check\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .select('id, role, removed_access')\n  .eq('user_id', user.id)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) redirect('/auth/verify-work-email');\nif (profile.removed_access) redirect('/auth/access-revoked');\n// User has active access, continue...\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Estimated Complexity\n\n| Task | Complexity | Lines of Code |\n\n|------|------------|---------------|\n\n| Delete old auth files | Trivial | -500 lines |\n\n| Security lockdown config | Trivial | ~20 lines TOML |\n\n| Database migration | Low | ~50 lines SQL (profiles, teams, indexes) |\n\n| Constants + validation | Trivial | ~25 lines |\n\n| Server actions (business logic) | Medium | ~80 lines |\n\n| Middleware update | Medium | ~50 lines (includes DB queries) |\n\n| Google login page | Low | ~30 lines |\n\n| Work email form + linking | Medium | ~120 lines |\n\n| Admin UI (profiles + teams) | Medium | ~150 lines |\n\n**Total new code**: ~525 lines (vs ~500 lines deleted)\n\n## Separation of Concerns\n\n### Supabase (Auth + Storage Only)\n\n- **Authentication**: Google OAuth flow, session management, OTP emails\n- **Database**: Store profiles, teams data with RLS for row-level access control\n- **No business logic**: No custom hooks, no stored procedures, no triggers for business rules\n\n### Next.js (All Business Logic)\n\n- **Middleware**: Profile verification, access checks, role-based routing\n- **Server Actions**: Profile linking, access revocation, team management\n- **Validation**: Domain validation, input sanitization, business rules",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [

      "codeBlock": {

            "line": 118,
            "column": 1
          }
        },
        "contents": "export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/login\";\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n\n  // If user is authenticated, check profile linking and access status\n  // Skip this check for admin routes (they handle their own auth in layout)\n  if (user &amp;&amp; !isPublicRoute &amp;&amp; !isAdminRoute) {\n    const { data: profile } = await supabase\n      .from('profiles')\n      .select('id, removed_access')\n      .eq('user_id', user.sub)\n      .single();\n\n    // If no profile linked, redirect to work email verification\n    if (!profile) {\n      const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n      url.pathname = \"/auth/verify-work-email\";\n      return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n    }\n}",

        "contents": "│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘│\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n                           │\n                           ▼\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                        Supabase                                  │\n│  ┌─────────────────────┐  ┌─────────────────────────────────┐   │\n│  │   Auth Service      │  │         PostgreSQL              │   │\n│  │  - Google OAuth     │  │  - profiles table               │   │\n│  │  - OTP emails       │  │  - teams table                  │   │\n│  │  - Session mgmt     │  │  - RLS policies (access ctrl)   │   │\n│  └─────────────────────┘  └─────────────────────────────────┘   │\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n\n## Simplicity Principles\n\n1. **No tRPC for auth** - Use Supabase client directly (fewer layers)\n2. **Business logic in Next.js** - Server actions and middleware handle all rules\n3. **Supabase for storage only** - No hooks, no custom functions, just tables + RLS\n4. **Minimal components** - Reuse shadcn/ui, no custom abstractions\n5. **Direct database queries** - Query profiles table for verification and access status\n6. **Admin-first onboarding** - Admin creates profiles, users link via work email verification",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {

          {

          },

        "contents": "skip_nonce_check = false\n# If enabled, it will allow the user to successfully authenticate when the provider does not return an email address.\nemail_optional = false\n\n[auth.external.google]\nenabled = true\nclient_id = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\"\nsecret = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\"\nredirect_uri = \"\"\nurl = \"\"\nskip_nonce_check = false\nemail_optional = false\n\n# Allow Solana wallet holders to sign in to your project via the Sign in with Solana (SIWS, EIP-4361) standard.\n# You can configure \"web3\" rate limit in the [auth.rate_limit] section and set up [auth.captcha] if self-hosting.\n[auth.web3.solana]\nenabled = false\n\n# Use Firebase Auth as a third-party provider alongside Supabase Auth.\n[auth.third_party.firebase]\nenabled = false\n# project_id = \"my-firebase-project\"\n\n# Use Auth0 as a third-party provider alongside Supabase Auth.\n[auth.third_party.auth0]\nenabled = false\n# tenant = \"my-auth0-tenant\"\n# tenant_region = \"us\"\n\n# Use AWS Cognito (Amplify) as a third-party provider alongside Supabase Auth.\n[auth.third_party.aws_cognito]\nenabled = false\n# user_pool_id = \"my-user-pool-id\"\n# user_pool_region = \"us-east-1\"\n\n# Use Clerk as a third-party provider alongside Supabase Auth.\n[auth.third_party.clerk]\nenabled = false\n# Obtain from https://clerk.com/setup/supabase\n# domain = \"example.clerk.accounts.dev\"\n\n# OAuth server configuration\n[auth.oauth_server]\n# Enable OAuth server functionality\nenabled = false\n# Path for OAuth consent flow UI\nauthorization_url_path = \"/oauth/consent\"\n# Allow dynamic client registration\nallow_dynamic_registration = false\n\n[edge_runtime]\nenabled = true\n# Supported request policies: &#96;oneshot&#96;, &#96;per_worker&#96;.\n# &#96;per_worker&#96;         "contents": "import { cookies } from \"next/headers\";\n\n/**\n * Especially important if using Fluid compute: Don't put this client in a\n * global variable. ## Summary

### Completed tasks

1. Cleanup — Deleted 8 password-based auth files
2. Security lockdown — Updated Supabase config:
   - Enabled Google OAuth only
   - Disabled email signup
   - Enabled manual linking
3. Database schema — Created migration with:
   - `profiles` table with RLS policies
   - `teams` table with RLS policies
   - Role enum and constraints
4. Constants — Created `lib/constants/auth.ts` with domain validation and role constants
5. Server actions — Created:
   - `lib/actions/auth.ts` — Profile linking, OTP verification, access management
   - `lib/actions/admin.ts` — Profile and team CRUD operations
6. Middleware — Updated `lib/supabase/proxy.ts` to:
   - Check profile linking status
   - Verify access is not revoked
   - Handle admin route protection
7. Google login — Created `GoogleLoginButton` component and updated login page
8. Work email verification — Created:
   - `WorkEmailForm` component with OTP flow
   - `/auth/verify-work-email` page
   - Updated `/auth/confirm` route for email link verification
9. Status pages — Created:
   - `/auth/pending-approval` — For users without profiles
   - `/auth/access-revoked` — For revoked access
10. Admin UI — Created:
    - `/admin/layout.tsx` — Admin layout with role check
    - `/admin/profiles/page.tsx` — Profile management with revoke/restore/delete
    - `/admin/teams/page.tsx` — Team management
    - Action components for client-side interactions
11. Auth button — Updated to show verified work email and admin link

### Key features

- Google OAuth only — No password-based authentication
- Work email verification — OTP verification for @studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz domains
- Profile linking — Links profiles to authenticated users after OTP verification
- Access management — Admins can revoke/restore access instantly
- Role-based access — Student, team_leader, coach, admin roles with hierarchy
- Admin-first onboarding — Admins create profiles, users link via work email

### Next steps

1. Run the migration: `supabase migration up` (or apply via Supabase dashboard)
2. Configure Google OAuth: Set `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID` and `GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET` in Supabase
3. Test the flow: Google login → Work email verification → Profile linking
4. Create admin profile: Create the first admin profile in the database

All code follows Next.js App Router patterns, uses server actions for mutations, and includes proper error handling and TypeScript types.

{
  "tools": [
    {
      "name": "apply_migration",
      "parameters": "{\"name\":\"auth_tables\",\"query\":\"-- Role enum for profiles\\ncreate type public.profile_role as enum ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin');\\n\\n-- Teams table\\ncreate table public.teams (\\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\\n  name text not null,\\n  picture text,\\n  color text,\\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null\\n);\\n\\n-- Profiles table (pre-created by admin, linked to user after verification)\\ncreate table public.profiles (\\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\\n  name text not null,\\n  picture text,  -- defaults to Google profile picture on link\\n  user_id uuid unique references auth.users(id) on delete set null,  -- linked after OTP verification\\n  work_email text unique not null,\\n  role public.profile_role not null default 'student',\\n  team_id uuid references public.teams(id) on delete set null,\\n  phone_number text,\\n  personal_email text,\\n  date_of_birth date,\\n  removed_access timestamptz,  -- null = active, set = revoked\\n  removed_access_by uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,\\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null,\\n  constraint valid_czu_domain check (\\n    work_email like '%@studenti.czu.cz' or work_email like '%@pef.czu.cz'\\n  )\\n);\\n\\n-- Indexes for common queries\\ncreate index profiles_user_id_idx on public.profiles(user_id);\\ncreate index profiles_work_email_idx on public.profiles(work_email);\\ncreate index profiles_team_id_idx on public.profiles(team_id);\\n\\n-- Enable RLS\\nalter table public.teams enable row level security;\\nalter table public.profiles enable row level security;\\n\\n-- RLS Policies for teams\\n-- Anyone authenticated can view teams\\ncreate policy \\\"Teams are viewable by authenticated users\\\"\\n  on public.teams for select\\n  using (auth.role() = 'authenticated');\\n\\n-- Only admins can insert/update/delete teams\\ncreate policy \\\"Only admins can manage teams\\\"\\n  on public.teams for all\\n  using (\\n    exists (\\n      select 1 from public.profiles\\n      where profiles.user_id = auth.uid()\\n      and profiles.role = 'admin'\\n      and profiles.removed_access is null\\n    )\\n  );\\n\\n-- RLS Policies for profiles\\n-- Users can view their own profile and profiles in their team\\ncreate policy \\\"Users can view their own profile and team profiles\\\"\\n  on public.profiles for select\\n  using (\\n    user_id = auth.uid()\\n    or (\\n      team_id is not null\\n      and team_id in (\\n        select team_id from public.profiles\\n        where user_id = auth.uid()\\n        and removed_access is null\\n      )\\n    )\\n    or exists (\\n      select 1 from public.profiles as admin_profile\\n      where admin_profile.user_id = auth.uid()\\n      and admin_profile.role = 'admin'\\n      and admin_profile.removed_access is null\\n    )\\n  );\\n\\n-- Users can update their own profile\\n-- Note: RLS policies don't support field-level restrictions easily\\n-- This policy allows users to update their own profile, but server-side validation\\n-- should enforce which fields can be updated\\ncreate policy \\\"Users can update their own profile\\\"\\n  on public.profiles for update\\n  using (user_id = auth.uid())\\n  with check (user_id = auth.uid());\\n\\n-- Only admins can create/delete profiles and manage access\\ncreate policy \\\"Only admins can manage profiles\\\"\\n  on public.profiles for all\\n  using (\\n    exists (\\n      select 1 from public.profiles\\n      where profiles.user_id = auth.uid()\\n      and profiles.role = 'admin'\\n      and profiles.removed_access is null\\n    )\\n  )\\n  with check (\\n    exists (\\n      select 1 from public.profiles\\n      where profiles.user_id = auth.uid()\\n      and profiles.role = 'admin'\\n      and profiles.removed_access is null\\n    )\\n  );\\n\\n-- Allow users to link their profile after OTP verification\\n-- This policy allows updating user_id when it's null (linking)\\ncreate policy \\\"Users can link their profile after verification\\\"\\n  on public.profiles for update\\n  using (\\n    user_id is null\\n    and work_email in (\\n      select email from auth.users where id = auth.uid()\\n    )\\n  )\\n  with check (\\n    user_id = auth.uid()\\n  );\"}",
      "serverName": "supabase"
    }
  ]
}

Database tables and RLS policies are set up correctly.

## Database setup complete

**Tables created:**
- `profiles` table with all columns and constraints
- `teams` table with all columns
- `profile_role` enum type with values: student, team_leader, coach, admin

**RLS policies verified:**

**Profiles table:**
- "Only admins can manage profiles" — Admins can create/delete profiles
- "Users can link their profile after verification" — Allows linking unlinked profiles after OTP verification
- "Users can update their own profile" — Users can update their own profile
- "Users can view their own profile and team profiles" — Users can view their profile, team members' profiles, and admins can view all

**Teams table:**
- "Teams are viewable by authenticated users" — All authenticated users can view teams
- "Only admins can manage teams" — Only admins can create/update/delete teams

**Security checks:**
- No security advisors found — all policies are properly configured

The database is ready. You can:
1. Create admin profiles via the Supabase dashboard or admin UI
2. Test the Google OAuth flow
3. Test work email verification and profile linking

The migration has been applied and the tables are ready to use.

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"-- Custom access token hook to embed claims in JWT\\n-- This function runs on every token refresh and adds custom claims\\ncreate or replace function public.custom_access_token_hook(event jsonb)\\nreturns jsonb\\nlanguage plpgsql\\nsecurity definer\\nset search_path = public\\nas $$\\ndeclare\\n  claims jsonb;\\n  user_role text;\\n  work_email text;\\n  is_approved boolean;\\nbegin\\n  -- Get user profile data\\n  select role, verified_work_email into user_role, work_email\\n  from public.user_profiles\\n  where id = (event-&amp;gt;&amp;gt;'user_id')::uuid;\\n\\n  -- Check if work email is in approved list\\n  select exists(\\n    select 1 from public.approved_emails where email = work_email\\n  ) into is_approved;\\n\\n  -- Build custom claims\\n  claims := coalesce(event-&amp;gt;'claims', '{}'::jsonb);\\n  claims := jsonb_set(claims, '{role}', to_jsonb(coalesce(user_role, 'user')));\\n  claims := jsonb_set(claims, '{verified_work_email}', to_jsonb(work_email));\\n  claims := jsonb_set(claims, '{is_app [... omitted end of long line]"
                },

                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"---\\nname: Work Email Auth System\\noverview: Build a robust authentication system using Supabase with Google OAuth, manual identity linking for work email verification (@studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz), and role-based permissions with admin management UI.\\ntodos:\\n  - id: cleanup-old-auth\\n    content: Delete unused password-based auth files (8 files)\\n    status: pending\\n  - id: security-lockdown\\n    content: Lock down Supabase to only allow Google OAuth (disable email signup, other providers)\\n    status: pending\\n  - id: db-schema\\n    content: Create Supabase migration for approved_emails and user_profiles tables with RLS\\n    status: pending\\n  - id: jwt-hook\\n    content: Create and test custom_access_token hook using Supabase MCP\\n    status: pending\\n  - id: supabase-config\\n    content: Update supabase/config.toml (manual_linking, Google OAuth, security settings)\\n    status: pending\\n  - id: auth-constants\\n    content: Create lib/constants/auth.ts with [... omitted end of long line]"

                  "lineNumber": 18538,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"create policy \\\"Users can update own profile\\\"\\n  on public.user_profiles\\n  for update\\n  using (id = auth.uid())\\n  with check (\\n    id = auth.uid() and\\n    -- Prevent users from changing their own role\\n    (old.role = new.role or old.role is null)\\n  );\\n\\n-- Allow system to insert user profiles (via trigger or admin)\\ncreate policy \\\"Allow user profile creation\\\"\\n  on public.user_profiles\\n  for insert\\n  with check (id = auth.uid());\\n\\n-- Admins can view all user profiles\\ncreate policy \\\"Admins can view all profiles\\\"\\n  on public.user_profiles\\n  for select\\n  using (\\n    exists (\\n      select 1 from public.user_profiles\\n      where id = auth.uid() and role = 'admin'\\n    )\\n  );\\n\\n-- Create function to automatically create user profile on user creation\\ncreate or replace function public.handle_new_user()\\nreturns trigger\\nlanguage plpgsql\\nsecurity definer\\nset search_path = public\\nas $$\\nbegin\\n  insert into public.user_profiles (id, google_email [... omitted end of long line]"

        "contents": "import { type EmailOtpType } from \"@supabase/supabase-js\";\nimport { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\n\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);\n  const token_hash = searchParams.get(\"token_hash\");\n  const type = searchParams.get(\"type\") as EmailOtpType | null;\n  const next = searchParams.get(\"next\") ?? \"/\";\n\n  if (token_hash &amp;&amp; type) {\n    const supabase = await createClient();\n\n    const { error: verifyError } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n      type,\n      token_hash,\n    });\n    \n    if (verifyError) {\n      redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=${encodeURIComponent(verifyError.message)}&#96;);\n    }\n\n    // After OTP verification via email link, redirect to verification page\n    // The user will need to enter their work email again to complete linking\n    // This is because we can't reliably get the work email from token_hash verification\n    redirect('/auth/verify-work-email?verified=true');\n  }\n\n  // redirect the user to an error page with some instructions\n  redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=No token hash or type&#96;);\n}",

        "contents": "| Access without verified work email          | Middleware checks &#96;profiles.user_id&#96; is linked   |\n\n| Unverified/fake work email                  | OTP verification required before linking            |\n\n| Non-CZU domain emails                       | Domain validation (client + server + DB constraint) |\n\n| Access without pre-created profile          | Profile must exist before linking (admin creates profiles)           |\n\n| Revoked access                              | Middleware checks &#96;profiles.removed_access IS NULL&#96;           |\n\n### Profile Verification (Next.js Middleware)\n\nAll verification logic lives in Next.js middleware, not in Supabase:\n\n- **Profile Linked**: Check &#96;profiles.user_id&#96; matches current auth.user.id\n- **Access Active**: Check &#96;profiles.removed_access IS NULL&#96;\n- **User Role**: Read &#96;profiles.role&#96; column (student, team_leader, coach, admin)\n\nThis approach:\n\n- Keeps all business logic in Next.js (single source of truth)\n- Allows real-time updates (e.g., instant access revocation)\n- Admin pre-creates profiles, users link via work email verification\n- Supabase only handles auth + data storage (no custom hooks or functions)\n\n## Development &amp; Testing with Supabase MCP\n\nThe project has a &#96;supabase/&#96; directory with Supabase MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration available for:\n\n1. **Running migrations**: Apply and test database schema changes locally\n2. **Querying tables**: Verify RLS policies and data integrity\n3. **Debugging auth flow**: Inspect user sessions and profile data\n4. **Testing verification logic**: Query profiles and teams tables\n\n**Useful MCP commands for development:**\n\n- Verify RLS policies by querying as different user roles\n- Seed test data into profiles and teams tables\n- Inspect auth.users and profiles tables\n- Test profile linking and access revocation queries\n\n## Files to DELETE (Password-based auth leftovers)\n\nThese files are for email+password authentication and are **not needed** with Google OAuth:\n\n| File | Reason |\n\n|------|--------|\n\n| &#96;components/login-form.tsx&#96; | Replaced by Google login button |",

        "contents": "## Architecture Overview\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid\nflowchart TD\n    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]\n        A[User clicks Google Login] --&gt; B[Google OAuth]\n        B --&gt; C[Redirect back with Google identity]\n        C --&gt; D{Profile linked to user?}\n        D --&gt;|No| E[Prompt for work email]\n        E --&gt; F{Domain is czu.cz?}\n        F --&gt;|No| G[Show domain error]\n        G --&gt; E\n        F --&gt;|Yes| H[Send OTP to work email]\n        H --&gt; I[User enters OTP]\n        I --&gt; J{Profile exists for work email?}\n        J --&gt;|No| K[Pending Approval Page]\n        J --&gt;|Yes| L[Link profile to user]\n        D --&gt;|Yes| M{Access revoked?}\n        L --&gt; M\n        M --&gt;|Yes| N[Show access revoked]\n        M --&gt;|No| O[Grant Full Access]\n    end\n\n    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]\n        P[Incoming Request] --&gt; Q[Middleware queries database]\n        Q --&gt; R{Profile linked to user?}\n        R --&gt;|No| S[Redirect to verify email]\n        R --&gt;|Yes| T{removed_access is null?}\n        T --&gt;|No| U[Show access revoked]\n        T --&gt;|Yes| V[Allow access]\n    end\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Validation Flow\n\n**Two-stage validation:**\n\n1. **Before OTP (Domain Check)**: Validate email ends with &#96;@studenti.czu.cz&#96; or &#96;@pef.czu.cz&#96;\n\n   - Client-side: Immediate feedback\n   - Server-side: Validated before &#96;signInWithOtp&#96; is called\n\n2. **After OTP (Profile Linking)**: Check if a profile exists for the verified work email\n\n   - If profile exists with that work_email → link profile to auth.user\n   - If no profile exists → show \"Pending Approval\" (admin must create profile first)\n   - Checked on every request via middleware\n\n## Database Schema (Supabase Migrations)\n\nThree tables with RLS policies managed entirely in Supabase:\n\n1. **&#96;auth.users&#96;** - Supabase-managed authentication (Google OAuth)\n2. **&#96;profiles&#96;** - User profile data with role and team membership\n3. **&#96;teams&#96;** - Team information\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Role enum for profiles\ncreate type public.profile_role as enum ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin');\n\n-- Teams table\ncreate table public.teams (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  name text not null,",

        "contents": "-- Role enum for profiles\ncreate type public.profile_role as enum ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin');\n\n-- Teams table\ncreate table public.teams (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  name text not null,\n  picture text,\n  color text,\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null\n);\n\n-- Profiles table (pre-created by admin, linked to user after verification)\ncreate table public.profiles (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  name text not null,\n  picture text,  -- defaults to Google profile picture on link\n  user_id uuid unique references auth.users(id) on delete set null,  -- linked after OTP verification\n  work_email text unique not null,\n  role public.profile_role not null default 'student',\n  team_id uuid references public.teams(id) on delete set null,\n  phone_number text,\n  personal_email text,\n  date_of_birth date,\n  removed_access timestamptz,  -- null = active, set = revoked\n  removed_access_by uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  constraint valid_czu_domain check (\n    work_email like '%@studenti.czu.cz' or work_email like '%@pef.czu.cz'\n  )\n);\n\n-- Indexes for common queries\ncreate index profiles_user_id_idx on public.profiles(user_id);\ncreate index profiles_work_email_idx on public.profiles(work_email);\ncreate index profiles_team_id_idx on public.profiles(team_id);\n\n-- Enable RLS\nalter table public.teams enable row level security;\nalter table public.profiles enable row level security;\n\n-- RLS Policies for teams\n-- Anyone authenticated can view teams\ncreate policy \"Teams are viewable by authenticated users\"\n  on public.teams for select\n  using (auth.role() = 'authenticated');\n\n-- Only admins can insert/update/delete teams\ncreate policy \"Only admins can manage teams\"\n  on public.teams for all",

        },
        "contents": "export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n\n\n  // If no user and not a public route, redirect to login\n  if (!user &amp;&amp; !isPublicRoute) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/login\";\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n\n  // If user is authenticated, check profile linking and access status\n  // Skip this check for admin routes (they handle their own auth in layout)\n  if (user &amp;&amp; !isPublicRoute &amp;&amp; !isAdminRoute) {\n    const { data: profile } = await supabase\n      .from('profiles')\n      .select('id, removed_access')\n      .eq('user_id', user.sub)\n      .single();\n\n    // If no profile linked, redirect to work email verification\n    if (!profile) {\n      const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n      url.pathname = \"/auth/verify-work-email\";\n      return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n    }\n\n    // If access is revoked, redirect to access revoked page\n    if (profile.removed_access) {\n      const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n      url.pathname = \"/auth/access-revoked\";\n      return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n    }\n  }\n  \n  // Admin routes: check admin role in middleware\n  if (user &amp;&amp; isAdminRoute) {\n    const { data: profile } = await supabase\n      .from('profiles')\n      .select('id, role, removed_access')\n      .eq('user_id', user.sub)\n      .single();\n\n    // If no profile or not admin, redirect\n    if (!profile || profile.role !== 'admin' || profile.removed_access) {\n      const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n      url.pathname = \"/protected\";\n      return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n    }\n  }\n\n  // IMPORTANT: You *must* return the supabaseResponse object as it is.\n  // If you're creating a new response object with NextResponse.next() make sure to:\n  // 1. Pass the request in it, like so:\n  //    const myNewResponse = NextResponse.next({ request })\n  // 2. Copy over the cookies, like so:\n  //    myNewResponse.cookies.setAll(supabaseResponse.cookies.getAll())\n  // 3. Change the myNewResponse object to fit your needs, but avoid changing\n  //    the cookies!\n  // 4. Finally:\n  //    return myNewResponse\n  // If this is not done, you may be causing the browser and server to go out\n  // of sync and terminate the user's session prematurely!\n\n  return supabaseResponse;\n}",

        "contents": "---\nname: Work Email Auth System\noverview: Build a robust authentication system using Supabase with Google OAuth, work email verification (@studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz), profile linking, team management, and role-based permissions (student, team_leader, coach, admin).\ntodos:\n  - id: cleanup-old-auth\n    content: Delete unused password-based auth files (8 files)\n    status: pending\n  - id: security-lockdown\n    content: Lock down Supabase to only allow Google OAuth (disable email signup, other providers)\n    status: pending\n  - id: db-schema\n    content: Create Supabase migration for profiles and teams tables with RLS\n    status: pending\n  - id: profile-verification\n    content: Implement database-based profile verification (no JWT claims)\n    status: pending\n  - id: supabase-config\n    content: Update supabase/config.toml (manual_linking, Google OAuth, security settings)\n    status: pending\n  - id: auth-constants\n    content: Create lib/constants/auth.ts with domain validation and role constants\n    status: pending\n  - id: server-actions\n    content: Create lib/actions/auth.ts with profile linking, verification, access management\n    status: pending\n  - id: middleware-update\n    content: Update proxy.ts to query profiles table for verified user and access status\n    status: pending\n  - id: google-login\n    content: Create Google login button and rewrite login page\n    status: pending\n  - id: verify-email-flow\n    content: Create work email verification page with OTP and identity linking\n    status: pending\n  - id: admin-ui\n    content: Create admin pages for managing profiles and teams\n    status: pending\n---\n\n# Work Email Authentication System\n\n## Architecture Overview\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid\nflowchart TD\n    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]\n        ",

        "contents": "1. **RLS Policies** (row-level access control):\n\n   - Users can only read/update their own profile (limited fields)\n   - Only admins can create/delete profiles and manage teams\n   - Team data viewable by team members\n\n2. **Database Constraints**:\n\n   - Domain constraint ensures only valid CZU domains in profiles\n   - Unique constraints on work_email, user_id\n\n### Next.js (Application Layer)\n\n1. **Middleware Verification**:\n\n   - Queries &#96;profiles&#96; table for linked user_id\n   - Checks &#96;removed_access&#96; is null for active access\n   - Enforces role-based route protection\n   - Real-time verification (instant access revocation)\n\n2. **Domain Validation** (in server actions):\n\n   - Client-side validation for UX (immediate feedback)\n   - Server-side validation before sending OTP\n   - Validates email format and CZU domain\n\n3. **Access Management** (in server actions):\n\n   - Admin sets &#96;removed_access&#96; timestamp and &#96;removed_access_by&#96; profile\n   - Immediate effect on next request\n   - Audit trail of who revoked access and when\n\n## Authentication Flow Details\n\n### Step 1: Google Login\n\nUser clicks Google login button, Supabase handles OAuth flow.\n\n### Step 2: Work Email Input with Domain Validation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Validate domain before sending OTP\nif (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(workEmail)) {\n  throw new Error('Email must be @studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz');\n}\n\n// Send OTP to work email (only after domain validation passes)\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  options: { shouldCreateUser: false }\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 3: OTP Verification and Profile Linking\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// After user enters OTP, verify it\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  token: otpCode,\n  type: 'email'\n});\n\n// Check if profile exists for this work email\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .select('id')\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) {\n  // No profile exists - redirect to pending approval",

        "contents": "'use client';\n\nimport { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport { useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation';\nimport { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';\nimport { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';\nimport { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';\nimport {\n  Card,\n  CardContent,\n  CardDescription,\n  CardHeader,\n  CardTitle,\n} from '@/components/ui/card';\nimport { isValidWorkEmailDomain } from '@/lib/constants/auth';\nimport { sendWorkEmailOTP, verifyWorkEmailOTP } from '@/lib/actions/auth';\n\n/**\n * Work email verification form component\n * Handles OTP sending and verification for work email linking\n */\nexport function WorkEmailForm() {\n  const searchParams = useSearchParams();\n  const verified = searchParams.get('verified') === 'true';\n  const [workEmail, setWorkEmail] = useState('');\n  const [otpCode, setOtpCode] = useState('');\n  const [step, setStep] = useState&lt;'email' | 'otp'&gt;('email');\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const [info, setInfo] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(\n    verified ?         "contents": "/**\n * Gets the current user's profile if linked\n * @returns Profile data or null if not linked\n */\nexport async function getCurrentUserProfile() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n\n  const { data: { user }, error: userError } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (userError || !user) {\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  const { data: profile } = await supabase\n    .from('profiles')\n    .select('*')\n    .eq('user_id', user.id)\n    .single();\n\n  return profile;\n}",

        "contents": "'use client';\n\nimport { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client';\nimport { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';\nimport { useState } from 'react';\nimport { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';\n\n/**\n * Google OAuth login button component\n * Initiates Google OAuth flow and redirects to work email verification after successful login\n */\nexport function GoogleLoginButton() {\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n  const router = useRouter();\n\n  const handleGoogleLogin = async () =&gt; {\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    const supabase = createClient();\n\n    try {\n      const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({\n        provider: 'google',\n        options: {\n          redirectTo: &#96;${window.location.origin}/auth/verify-work-email&#96;,\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (error) {\n        console.error('Google login error:', error);\n        router.push(&#96;/auth/error?error=${encodeURIComponent(error.message)}&#96;);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Unexpected error during Google login:', error);\n      router.push(&#96;/auth/error?error=${encodeURIComponent('An unexpected error occurred')}&#96;);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;Button\n      onClick={handleGoogleLogin}\n      disabled={isLoading}\n}",

        "contents": "'use server';\n\nimport { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';\nimport { isValidWorkEmailDomain } from '@/lib/constants/auth';\nimport { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache';\nimport { redirect } from 'next/navigation';\n\n/**\n * Sends an OTP to the provided work email for verification\n * @param workEmail - The work email address to send OTP to\n * @returns Object with success status and optional error message\n */\nexport async function sendWorkEmailOTP(workEmail: string) {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n\n  // Validate domain before sending OTP\n  if (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(workEmail)) {\n    return {\n      success: false,\n      error: 'Email must be @studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz',\n    };\n  }\n\n  // Send OTP to work email (shouldCreateUser: false prevents new user creation)\n  const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({\n    email: workEmail,\n    options: {\n      shouldCreateUser: false,\n    },\n  });\n\n  if (error) {\n    return {\n      success: false,\n      error: error.message,\n    };\n  }\n\n  return {\n    success: true,\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * Verifies OTP code and links profile to authenticated user\n * @param workEmail - The work email address that received the OTP\n * @param otpCode - The OTP code entered by the user\n * @returns Object with success status and optional error message\n */",

      "codeBlock": {

        "contents": "-- Teams table\ncreate table public.teams (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  name text not null,\n  picture text,\n  color text,\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null\n);\n\n-- Profiles table (pre-created by admin, linked to user after verification)\ncreate table public.profiles (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  name text not null,\n  picture text,  -- defaults to Google profile picture on link\n  user_id uuid unique references auth.users(id) on delete set null,  -- linked after OTP verification\n  work_email text unique not null,\n  role public.profile_role not null default 'student',\n  team_id uuid references public.teams(id) on delete set null,\n  phone_number text,\n  personal_email text,\n  date_of_birth date,\n  removed_access timestamptz,  -- null = active, set = revoked\n  removed_access_by uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  constraint valid_czu_domain check (\n    work_email like '%@studenti.czu.cz' or work_email like '%@pef.czu.cz'\n  )\n);\n\n-- Indexes for common queries\ncreate index profiles_user_id_idx on public.profiles(user_id);\ncreate index profiles_work_email_idx on public.profiles(work_email);\ncreate index profiles_team_id_idx on public.profiles(team_id);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n\n&gt; **Note**: &#96;updated_at&#96; is set by Next.js server actions on each update, not via database triggers. This keeps all logic in the application layer.\n\n### Entity Relationships\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n┌─────────────────┐       ┌─────────────────┐       ┌─────────────────┐\n│   auth.users    │       │    profiles     │       │     teams       │\n│  (Supabase)     │       │                 │       │                 │\n├─────────────────┤       ├─────────────────┤       ├─────────────────┤\n│ id (uuid)       │◄──┐   │ id (uuid)       │   ┌──►│ id (uuid)       │",

        "contents": "if (!profile) {\n  // No profile exists - redirect to pending approval\n  redirect('/auth/pending-approval');\n}\n\n// Link profile to current user\nconst { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\nawait supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .update({ \n    user_id: user.id,\n    picture: user.user_metadata.avatar_url  // Default to Google picture\n  })\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 4: Middleware Validation\n\nQuery database for profile linked to current auth.user and check &#96;removed_access IS NULL&#96; on every request to protected routes.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Middleware check\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .select('id, role, removed_access')\n  .eq('user_id', user.id)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) redirect('/auth/verify-work-email');\nif (profile.removed_access) redirect('/auth/access-revoked');\n// User has active access, continue...\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Estimated Complexity\n\n| Task | Complexity | Lines of Code |\n\n|------|------------|---------------|\n\n| Delete old auth files | Trivial | -500 lines |\n\n| Security lockdown config | Trivial | ~20 lines TOML |\n\n| Database migration | Low | ~50 lines SQL (profiles, teams, indexes) |\n\n| Constants + validation | Trivial | ~25 lines |\n\n| Server actions (business logic) | Medium | ~80 lines |\n\n| Middleware update | Medium | ~50 lines (includes DB queries) |\n\n| Google login page | Low | ~30 lines |\n\n| Work email form + linking | Medium | ~120 lines |\n\n| Admin UI (profiles + teams) | Medium | ~150 lines |\n\n**Total new code**: ~525 lines (vs ~500 lines deleted)\n\n## Separation of Concerns\n\n### Supabase (Auth + Storage Only)\n\n- **Authentication**: Google OAuth flow, session management, OTP emails\n- **Database**: Store profiles, teams data with RLS for row-level access control\n- **No business logic**: No custom hooks, no stored procedures, no triggers for business rules\n\n### Next.js (All Business Logic)\n\n- **Middleware**: Profile verification, access checks, role-based routing\n- **Server Actions**: Profile linking, access revocation, team management\n- **Validation**: Domain validation, input sanitization, business rules",

        "contents": "import Link from \"next/link\";\nimport { Button } from \"./ui/button\";\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/server\";\nimport { LogoutButton } from \"./logout-button\";\nimport { getCurrentUserProfile } from \"@/lib/actions/auth\";\n\nexport async function AuthButton() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n\n  // You can also use getUser() which will be slower.\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  const user = data?.claims;\n\n  if (!user) {\n    return (\n      &lt;div className=\"flex gap-2\"&gt;\n        &lt;Button asChild size=\"sm\" variant={\"outline\"}&gt;\n          &lt;Link href=\"/auth/login\"&gt;Sign in&lt;/Link&gt;\n        &lt;/Button&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    );\n  }\n\n  // Get profile to show work email\n  const profile = await getCurrentUserProfile();\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"flex items-center gap-4\"&gt;\n      {profile ? (\n        &lt;&gt;\n          &lt;span className=\"text-sm\"&gt;\n            {profile.work_email}\n            {profile.role !== 'student' &amp;&amp; (\n              &lt;span className=\"ml-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground\"&gt;\n                ({profile.role})\n              &lt;/span&gt;\n            )}\n          &lt;/span&gt;\n          {profile.role === 'admin' &amp;&amp; (\n            &lt;Button asChild size=\"sm\" variant={\"outline\"}&gt;\n              &lt;Link href=\"/admin/profiles\"&gt;Admin&lt;/Link&gt;\n            &lt;/Button&gt;\n          )}\n        &lt;/&gt;\n      ) : (\n        &lt;span className=\"text-sm text-muted-foreground\"&gt;\n          {user.email}\n        &lt;/span&gt;\n      )}\n      &lt;LogoutButton /&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  );\n}",

        "contents": "'studenti.czu.cz',\n  'pef.czu.cz',\n] as const;\n\nexport const isValidWorkEmailDomain = (email: string): boolean =&gt; {\n  const domain = email.split('@')[1]?.toLowerCase();\n  return ALLOWED_WORK_EMAIL_DOMAINS.includes(domain as any);\n};\n\n// Profile roles (matches database enum)\nexport const PROFILE_ROLES = ['student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin'] as const;\nexport type ProfileRole = typeof PROFILE_ROLES[number];\n\n// Role hierarchy for permission checks\nexport const ROLE_HIERARCHY: Record&lt;ProfileRole, number&gt; = {\n  student: 0,\n  team_leader: 1,\n  coach: 2,\n  admin: 3,\n} as const;\n\nexport const hasMinimumRole = (userRole: ProfileRole, requiredRole: ProfileRole): boolean =&gt; {\n  return ROLE_HIERARCHY[userRole] &gt;= ROLE_HIERARCHY[requiredRole];\n};\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Supabase Configuration Changes\n\nUpdate [&#96;supabase/config.toml&#96;](supabase/config.toml):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth]\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking\nenable_anonymous_sign_ins = false   # Block anonymous access\n\n[auth.email]\nenable_signup = false               # Block direct email/password signup\nenable_confirmations = false        # We use OTP for work email, not signup confirmation\n\n[auth.external.google]\nenabled = true\nclient_id = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\"\nsecret = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Security Lockdown (Google OAuth Only)\n\n**Goal**: Users can ONLY authenticate via Google OAuth + work email verification. All other methods are blocked.\n\n### Blocked Scenarios\n\n| Attack Vector                               | How It's Blocked                                    |\n\n| ------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |\n\n| Direct email/password signup                | &#96;enable_signup = false&#96; in auth.email               |\n\n| Other OAuth providers (Apple, GitHub, etc.) | All providers disabled except Google                |\n\n| Anonymous access                            | &#96;enable_anonymous_sign_ins = false&#96;                 |\n\n| Access without verified work email          | Middleware checks &#96;profiles.user_id&#96; is linked   |\n\n| Unverified/fake work email                  | OTP verification required before linking            |",

        "contents": "import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\nimport { hasEnvVars } from \"../utils\";\n\nexport async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  // If the env vars are not set, skip proxy check. You can remove this\n  // once you setup the project.\n  if (!hasEnvVars) {\n    return supabaseResponse;\n  }\n\n  // With Fluid compute, don't put this client in a global environment\n  // variable. Always create a new one on each request.\n  const supabase = createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return request.cookies.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt;\n            request.cookies.set(name, value),\n          );\n          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n            request,\n          });\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt;\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options),\n          );\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n\n  // Do not run code between createServerClient and\n  // supabase.auth.getClaims(). A simple mistake could make it very hard to debug\n  // issues with users being randomly logged out.\n\n  // IMPORTANT: If you remove getClaims() and you use server-side rendering\n  // with the Supabase client, your users may be randomly logged out.\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n  const user = data?.claims;\n\n  // Public routes that don't require authentication\n  const publicRoutes = ['/', '/auth/login', '/auth/error', '/auth/pending-approval', '/auth/access-revoked', '/auth/verify-work-email'];\n  const isPublicRoute = publicRoutes.includes(request.nextUrl.pathname) || \n    request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith('/auth/');\n  \n  // Admin routes require admin role check (handled in admin layout)\n  const isAdminRoute = request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith('/admin/');\n\n  // If no user and not a public route, redirect to login\n}",

        "contents": "import { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/server\";\nimport { InfoIcon } from \"lucide-react\";\nimport { FetchDataSteps } from \"@/components/tutorial/fetch-data-steps\";\nimport { Suspense } from \"react\";\n\nasync function UserDetails() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  if (error || !data?.claims) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/login\");\n  }\n\n  return JSON.stringify(data.claims, null, 2);\n}\n\nexport default function ProtectedPage() {\n  return\n}",

Creating a `users` table in the public schema to track authenticated but unverified users (those who logged in with Google but haven't linked a profile):


---

<tool-use data-tool-type="unknown" data-tool-name="mcp-supabase-user-supabase-apply_migration">
<details>
<summary>Tool use: **mcp-supabase-user-supabase-apply_migration**</summary>


Parameters:
