{
  "tools": [
    {
      "name": "apply_migration",
      "parameters": "{\"name\":\"add_users_table\",\"query\":\"-- Users table to track authenticated users (including unverified ones)\\n-- This table syncs with auth.users and tracks verification status\\ncreate table public.users (\\n  id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,\\n  email text not null,\\n  name text,\\n  picture text,\\n  profile_id uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,\\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null\\n);\\n\\n-- Index for common queries\\ncreate index users_profile_id_idx on public.users(profile_id);\\ncreate index users_email_idx on public.users(email);\\n\\n-- Enable RLS\\nalter table public.users enable row level security;\\n\\n-- RLS Policies for users\\n-- Users can view their own record\\ncreate policy \\\"Users can view their own record\\\"\\n  on public.users for select\\n  using (id = auth.uid());\\n\\n-- Admins can view all users\\ncreate policy \\\"Admins can view all users\\\"\\n  on public.users for select\\n  using (\\n    exists (\\n      select 1 from public.profiles\\n      where profiles.user_id = auth.uid()\\n      and profiles.role = 'admin'\\n      and profiles.removed_access is null\\n    )\\n  );\\n\\n-- Function to automatically create user record when auth.users is created\\ncreate or replace function public.handle_new_user()\\nreturns trigger\\nlanguage plpgsql\\nsecurity definer\\nset search_path = public\\nas $$\\nbegin\\n  insert into public.users (id, email, name, picture)\\n  values (\\n    new.id,\\n    new.email,\\n    coalesce(new.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'full_name', new.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'name'),\\n    new.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'avatar_url'\\n  )\\n  on conflict (id) do update\\n  set\\n    email = excluded.email,\\n    name = coalesce(excluded.name, public.users.name),\\n    picture = coalesce(excluded.picture, public.users.picture),\\n    updated_at = now();\\n  return new;\\nend;\\n$$;\\n\\n-- Trigger to sync auth.users to public.users\\ncreate trigger on_auth_user_created\\n  after insert or update on auth.users\\n  for each row\\n  execute function public.handle_new_user();\\n\\n-- Function to sync profile_id when profile is linked\\ncreate or replace function public.sync_profile_link()\\nreturns trigger\\nlanguage plpgsql\\nsecurity definer\\nset search_path = public\\nas $$\\nbegin\\n  -- When profile.user_id is set, update users.profile_id\\n  if new.user_id is not null then\\n    update public.users\\n    set profile_id = new.id,\\n        updated_at = now()\\n    where id = new.user_id;\\n  end if;\\n  \\n  -- When profile.user_id is cleared, clear users.profile_id\\n  if new.user_id is null and old.user_id is not null then\\n    update public.users\\n    set profile_id = null,\\n        updated_at = now()\\n    where id = old.user_id;\\n  end if;\\n  \\n  return new;\\nend;\\n$$;\\n\\n-- Trigger to sync profile linking\\ncreate trigger on_profile_linked\\n  after update of user_id on public.profiles\\n  for each row\\n  when (new.user_id is distinct from old.user_id)\\n  execute function public.sync_profile_link();\"}",
      "serverName": "supabase"
    }
  ]
}

## Summary

**Created `users` table:**
- Tracks all authenticated users (including unverified)
- Syncs automatically with `auth.users` via trigger
- Links to `profiles` via `profile_id`
- Stores Google OAuth data (email, name, picture)

**Features:**
1. Automatic sync — Trigger creates/updates `public.users` when users authenticate
2. Profile linking sync — When a profile is linked, `users.profile_id` updates automatically
3. Admin visibility — Admins can see all users, including unverified ones
4. RLS policies — Users can view their own record; admins can view all

**Admin UI:**
- New `/admin/users` page shows:
  - All authenticated users
  - Verification status (Verified & Active, Access Revoked, or Unverified)
  - Work email and role (if verified)
  - Profile picture from Google

**Current status:**
- 1 total user
- 1 unverified user (authenticated but no profile linked)
- 0 verified users

The `users` table is ready and tracking authenticated users. Admins can view unverified users in the admin panel.

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./lib/actions/auth.ts",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 41,
            "column": 1
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 121,
            "column": 3
          }
        },
        "contents": "/**\n * Verifies OTP code and links profile to authenticated user\n * @param workEmail - The work email address that received the OTP\n * @param otpCode - The OTP code entered by the user\n * @returns Object with success status and optional error message\n */\nexport async function verifyWorkEmailOTP(workEmail: string, otpCode: string) {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n\n  // Verify OTP\n  const { error: verifyError } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n    email: workEmail,\n    token: otpCode,\n    type: 'email',\n  });\n\n  if (verifyError) {\n    return {\n      success: false,\n      error: verifyError.message,\n    };\n  }\n\n  // Get current authenticated user\n  const { data: { user }, error: userError } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (userError || !user) {\n    return {\n      success: false,\n      error: 'Failed to get authenticated user',\n    };\n  }\n\n  // Check if profile exists for this work email\n  const { data: profile, error: profileError } = await supabase\n    .from('profiles')\n    .select('id, user_id')\n    .eq('work_email', workEmail.toLowerCase())\n    .single();\n\n  if (profileError || !profile) {\n    // No profile exists - user needs admin approval\n    redirect('/auth/pending-approval');\n  }\n\n  // Check if profile is already linked to another user\n  if (profile.user_id &amp;&amp; profile.user_id !== user.id) {\n    return {\n      success: false,\n      error: 'This work email is already linked to another account',\n    };\n  }\n\n  // Link profile to current user\n  const { error: updateError } = await supabase\n    .from('profiles')\n    .update({\n      user_id: user.id,\n      picture: user.user_metadata?.avatar_url || null,\n      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),\n    })\n    .eq('work_email', workEmail.toLowerCase());\n\n  if (updateError) {\n    return {\n      success: false,\n      error: updateError.message,\n    };\n  }\n\n  revalidatePath('/');\n  redirect('/protected');\n}\n\n/**\n * Revokes access for a user profile\n * @param profileId - The ID of the profile to revoke access for\n * @returns Object with success status and optional error message\n */",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./lib/supabase/proxy.ts",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 4
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 118,
            "column": 1
          }
        },
        "contents": "export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n\n\n  // If no user and not a public route, redirect to login\n  if (!user &amp;&amp; !isPublicRoute) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/login\";\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n\n  // If user is authenticated, check profile linking and access status\n  // Skip this check for admin routes (they handle their own auth in layout)\n  if (user &amp;&amp; !isPublicRoute &amp;&amp; !isAdminRoute) {\n    const { data: profile } = await supabase\n      .from('profiles')\n      .select('id, removed_access')\n      .eq('user_id', user.sub)\n      .single();\n\n    // If no profile linked, redirect to work email verification\n    if (!profile) {\n      const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n      url.pathname = \"/auth/verify-work-email\";\n      return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n    }\n\n    // If access is revoked, redirect to access revoked page\n    if (profile.removed_access) {\n      const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n      url.pathname = \"/auth/access-revoked\";\n      return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n    }\n  }\n  \n  // Admin routes: check admin role in middleware\n  if (user &amp;&amp; isAdminRoute) {\n    const { data: profile } = await supabase\n      .from('profiles')\n      .select('id, role, removed_access')\n      .eq('user_id', user.sub)\n      .single();\n\n    // If no profile or not admin, redirect\n    if (!profile || profile.role !== 'admin' || profile.removed_access) {\n      const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n      url.pathname = \"/protected\";\n      return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n    }\n  }\n\n  // IMPORTANT: You *must* return the supabaseResponse object as it is.\n  // If you're creating a new response object with NextResponse.next() make sure to:\n  // 1. Pass the request in it, like so:\n  //    const myNewResponse = NextResponse.next({ request })\n  // 2. Copy over the cookies, like so:\n  //    myNewResponse.cookies.setAll(supabaseResponse.cookies.getAll())\n  // 3. Change the myNewResponse object to fit your needs, but avoid changing\n  //    the cookies!\n  // 4. Finally:\n  //    return myNewResponse\n  // If this is not done, you may be causing the browser and server to go out\n  // of sync and terminate the user's session prematurely!\n\n  return supabaseResponse;\n}",

        "contents": "import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\nimport { hasEnvVars } from \"../utils\";\n\nexport async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  // If the env vars are not set, skip proxy check. You can remove this\n  // once you setup the project.\n  if (!hasEnvVars) {\n    return supabaseResponse;\n  }\n\n  // With Fluid compute, don't put this client in a global environment\n  // variable. Always create a new one on each request.\n  const supabase = createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return request.cookies.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt;\n            request.cookies.set(name, value),\n          );\n          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n            request,\n          });\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt;\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options),\n          );\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n\n  // Do not run code between createServerClient and\n  // supabase.auth.getClaims(). A simple mistake could make it very hard to debug\n  // issues with users being randomly logged out.\n\n  // IMPORTANT: If you remove getClaims() and you use server-side rendering\n  // with the Supabase client, your users may be randomly logged out.\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n  const user = data?.claims;\n\n  // Public routes that don't require authentication\n  const publicRoutes = ['/', '/auth/login', '/auth/error', '/auth/pending-approval', '/auth/access-revoked', '/auth/verify-work-email'];\n  const isPublicRoute = publicRoutes.includes(request.nextUrl.pathname) || \n    request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith('/auth/');\n  \n  // Admin routes require admin role check (handled in admin layout)\n  const isAdminRoute = request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith('/admin/');\n\n  // If no user and not a public route, redirect to login\n}",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "file_size_limit = \"50MiB\"\n\n# Uncomment to configure local storage buckets\n# [storage.buckets.images]\n# public = false\n# file_size_limit = \"50MiB\"\n# allowed_mime_types = [\"image/png\", \"image/jpeg\"]\n# objects_path = \"./images\"\n\n# Allow connections via S3 compatible clients\n[storage.s3_protocol]\nenabled = true\n\n# Image transformation API is available to Supabase Pro plan.\n# [storage.image_transformation]\n# enabled = true\n\n# Store analytical data in S3 for running ETL jobs over Iceberg Catalog\n# This feature is only available on the hosted platform.\n[storage.analytics]\nenabled = false\nmax_namespaces = 5\nmax_tables = 10\nmax_catalogs = 2\n\n# Analytics Buckets is available to Supabase Pro plan.\n# [storage.analytics.buckets.my-warehouse]\n\n# Store vector embeddings in S3 for large and durable datasets\n# This feature is only available on the hosted platform.\n[storage.vector]\nenabled = false\nmax_buckets = 10\nmax_indexes = 5\n\n# Vector Buckets is available to Supabase Pro plan.\n# [storage.vector.buckets.documents-openai]\n\n[auth]\nenabled = true\n# The base URL of your website. Used as an allow-list for redirects and for constructing URLs used\n# in emails.\nsite_url = \"http://127.0.0.1:3000\"\n# A list of *exact* URLs that auth providers are permitted to redirect to post authentication.\nadditional_redirect_urls = [\"https://127.0.0.1:3000\"]\n# How long tokens are valid for, in seconds. Defaults to 3600 (1 hour), maximum 604,800 (1 week).\njwt_expiry = 3600\n# JWT issuer URL.         "contents": "1. **RLS Policies** (row-level access control):\n\n   - Users can only read/update their own profile (limited fields)\n   - Only admins can create/delete profiles and manage teams\n   - Team data viewable by team members\n\n2. **Database Constraints**:\n\n   - Domain constraint ensures only valid CZU domains in profiles\n   - Unique constraints on work_email, user_id\n\n### Next.js (Application Layer)\n\n1. **Middleware Verification**:\n\n   - Queries &#96;profiles&#96; table for linked user_id\n   - Checks &#96;removed_access&#96; is null for active access\n   - Enforces role-based route protection\n   - Real-time verification (instant access revocation)\n\n2. **Domain Validation** (in server actions):\n\n   - Client-side validation for UX (immediate feedback)\n   - Server-side validation before sending OTP\n   - Validates email format and CZU domain\n\n3. **Access Management** (in server actions):\n\n   - Admin sets &#96;removed_access&#96; timestamp and &#96;removed_access_by&#96; profile\n   - Immediate effect on next request\n   - Audit trail of who revoked access and when\n\n## Authentication Flow Details\n\n### Step 1: Google Login\n\nUser clicks Google login button, Supabase handles OAuth flow.\n\n### Step 2: Work Email Input with Domain Validation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Validate domain before sending OTP\nif (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(workEmail)) {\n  throw new Error('Email must be @studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz');\n}\n\n// Send OTP to work email (only after domain validation passes)\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  options: { shouldCreateUser: false }\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 3: OTP Verification and Profile Linking\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// After user enters OTP, verify it\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  token: otpCode,\n  type: 'email'\n});\n\n// Check if profile exists for this work email\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .select('id')\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) {\n  // No profile exists - redirect to pending approval",

        "contents": "## Architecture Overview\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid\nflowchart TD\n    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]\n        A[User clicks Google Login] --&gt; B[Google OAuth]\n        B --&gt; C[Redirect back with Google identity]\n        C --&gt; D{Profile linked to user?}\n        D --&gt;|No| E[Prompt for work email]\n        E --&gt; F{Domain is czu.cz?}\n        F --&gt;|No| G[Show domain error]\n        G --&gt; E\n        F --&gt;|Yes| H[Send OTP to work email]\n        H --&gt; I[User enters OTP]\n        I --&gt; J{Profile exists for work email?}\n        J --&gt;|No| K[Pending Approval Page]\n        J --&gt;|Yes| L[Link profile to user]\n        D --&gt;|Yes| M{Access revoked?}\n        L --&gt; M\n        M --&gt;|Yes| N[Show access revoked]\n        M --&gt;|No| O[Grant Full Access]\n    end\n\n    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]\n        P[Incoming Request] --&gt; Q[Middleware queries database]\n        Q --&gt; R{Profile linked to user?}\n        R --&gt;|No| S[Redirect to verify email]\n        R --&gt;|Yes| T{removed_access is null?}\n        T --&gt;|No| U[Show access revoked]\n        T --&gt;|Yes| V[Allow access]\n    end\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Validation Flow\n\n**Two-stage validation:**\n\n1. **Before OTP (Domain Check)**: Validate email ends with &#96;@studenti.czu.cz&#96; or &#96;@pef.czu.cz&#96;\n\n   - Client-side: Immediate feedback\n   - Server-side: Validated before &#96;signInWithOtp&#96; is called\n\n2. **After OTP (Profile Linking)**: Check if a profile exists for the verified work email\n\n   - If profile exists with that work_email → link profile to auth.user\n   - If no profile exists → show \"Pending Approval\" (admin must create profile first)\n   - Checked on every request via middleware\n\n## Database Schema (Supabase Migrations)\n\nThree tables with RLS policies managed entirely in Supabase:\n\n1. **&#96;auth.users&#96;** - Supabase-managed authentication (Google OAuth)\n2. **&#96;profiles&#96;** - User profile data with role and team membership\n3. **&#96;teams&#96;** - Team information\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Role enum for profiles\ncreate type public.profile_role as enum ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin');\n\n-- Teams table\ncreate table public.teams (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  name text not null,",

        "contents": "'use server';\n\nimport { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';\nimport { isValidWorkEmailDomain } from '@/lib/constants/auth';\nimport { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache';\nimport { redirect } from 'next/navigation';\n\n/**\n * Sends an OTP to the provided work email for verification\n * @param workEmail - The work email address to send OTP to\n * @returns Object with success status and optional error message\n */\nexport async function sendWorkEmailOTP(workEmail: string) {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n\n  // Validate domain before sending OTP\n  if (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(workEmail)) {\n    return {\n      success: false,\n      error: 'Email must be @studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz',\n    };\n  }\n\n  // Send OTP to work email (shouldCreateUser: false prevents new user creation)\n  const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({\n    email: workEmail,\n    options: {\n      shouldCreateUser: false,\n    },\n  });\n\n  if (error) {\n    return {\n      success: false,\n      error: error.message,\n    };\n  }\n\n  return {\n    success: true,\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * Verifies OTP code and links profile to authenticated user\n * @param workEmail - The work email address that received the OTP\n * @param otpCode - The OTP code entered by the user\n * @returns Object with success status and optional error message\n */",

        "contents": "# This hook runs before a token is issued and allows you to add additional claims based on the authentication method used.\n# [auth.hook.custom_access_token]\n# enabled = true\n# uri = \"pg-functions://&lt;database&gt;/&lt;schema&gt;/&lt;hook_name&gt;\"\n\n# Configure one of the supported SMS providers: &#96;twilio&#96;, &#96;twilio_verify&#96;, &#96;messagebird&#96;, &#96;textlocal&#96;, &#96;vonage&#96;.\n[auth.sms.twilio]\nenabled = false\naccount_sid = \"\"\nmessage_service_sid = \"\"\n# DO NOT commit your Twilio auth token to git. Use environment variable substitution instead:\nauth_token = \"env(SUPABASE_AUTH_SMS_TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN)\"\n\n# Multi-factor-authentication is available to Supabase Pro plan.\n[auth.mfa]\n# Control how many MFA factors can be enrolled at once per user.\nmax_enrolled_factors = 10\n\n# Control MFA via App Authenticator (TOTP)\n[auth.mfa.totp]\nenroll_enabled = false\nverify_enabled = false\n\n# Configure MFA via Phone Messaging\n[auth.mfa.phone]\nenroll_enabled = false\nverify_enabled = false\notp_length = 6\ntemplate = \"Your code is {{ .Code }}\"\nmax_frequency = \"5s\"\n\n# Configure MFA via WebAuthn\n# [auth.mfa.web_authn]\n# enroll_enabled = true\n# verify_enabled = true\n\n# Use an external OAuth provider.         "contents": "'studenti.czu.cz',\n  'pef.czu.cz',\n] as const;\n\nexport const isValidWorkEmailDomain = (email: string): boolean =&gt; {\n  const domain = email.split('@')[1]?.toLowerCase();\n  return ALLOWED_WORK_EMAIL_DOMAINS.includes(domain as any);\n};\n\n// Profile roles (matches database enum)\nexport const PROFILE_ROLES = ['student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin'] as const;\nexport type ProfileRole = typeof PROFILE_ROLES[number];\n\n// Role hierarchy for permission checks\nexport const ROLE_HIERARCHY: Record&lt;ProfileRole, number&gt; = {\n  student: 0,\n  team_leader: 1,\n  coach: 2,\n  admin: 3,\n} as const;\n\nexport const hasMinimumRole = (userRole: ProfileRole, requiredRole: ProfileRole): boolean =&gt; {\n  return ROLE_HIERARCHY[userRole] &gt;= ROLE_HIERARCHY[requiredRole];\n};\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Supabase Configuration Changes\n\nUpdate [&#96;supabase/config.toml&#96;](supabase/config.toml):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth]\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking\nenable_anonymous_sign_ins = false   # Block anonymous access\n\n[auth.email]\nenable_signup = false               # Block direct email/password signup\nenable_confirmations = false        # We use OTP for work email, not signup confirmation\n\n[auth.external.google]\nenabled = true\nclient_id = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\"\nsecret = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Security Lockdown (Google OAuth Only)\n\n**Goal**: Users can ONLY authenticate via Google OAuth + work email verification. All other methods are blocked.\n\n### Blocked Scenarios\n\n| Attack Vector                               | How It's Blocked                                    |\n\n| ------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |\n\n| Direct email/password signup                | &#96;enable_signup = false&#96; in auth.email               |\n\n| Other OAuth providers (Apple, GitHub, etc.) | All providers disabled except Google                |\n\n| Anonymous access                            | &#96;enable_anonymous_sign_ins = false&#96;                 |\n\n| Access without verified work email          | Middleware checks &#96;profiles.user_id&#96; is linked   |\n\n| Unverified/fake work email                  | OTP verification required before linking            |",

        "contents": "import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';\nimport Link from 'next/link';\nimport { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';\nimport { AuthButton } from '@/components/auth-button';\nimport { Suspense } from 'react';\n\n/**\n * Admin layout with role-based access control\n * Only admins can access admin routes\n */\nexport default async function AdminLayout({\n  children,\n}: {\n  children: React.ReactNode;\n}) {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (!user) {\n    redirect('/auth/login');\n  }\n\n  // Check if user is admin\n  const { data: profile } = await supabase\n    .from('profiles')\n    .select('id, role')\n    .eq('user_id', user.id)\n    .eq('role', 'admin')\n    .is('removed_access', null)\n    .single();\n\n  if (!profile) {\n    redirect('/protected');\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;main className=\"min-h-screen flex flex-col\"&gt;\n      &lt;nav className=\"w-full flex justify-center border-b border-b-foreground/10 h-16\"&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"w-full max-w-7xl flex justify-between items-center p-3 px-5 text-sm\"&gt;\n          &lt;div className=\"flex gap-5 items-center font-semibold\"&gt;\n            &lt;Link href=\"/protected\"&gt;Home&lt;/Link&gt;\n            &lt;Link href=\"/admin/users\"&gt;Users&lt;/Link&gt;\n            &lt;Link href=\"/admin/profiles\"&gt;Profiles&lt;/Link&gt;\n            &lt;Link href=\"/admin/teams\"&gt;Teams&lt;/Link&gt;\n          &lt;/div&gt;\n          &lt;Suspense&gt;\n            &lt;AuthButton /&gt;\n          &lt;/Suspense&gt;\n        &lt;/div&gt;\n      &lt;/nav&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"flex-1 container mx-auto p-6\"&gt;\n        {children}\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    &lt;/main&gt;\n  );\n}",

'OTP verified via email link. Please enter your work email to complete linking.' : null\n  );\n\n  const handleSendOTP = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    setError(null);\n    setIsLoading(true);\n\n    if (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(workEmail)) {\n      setError('Email must be @studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz');\n      setIsLoading(false);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const result = await sendWorkEmailOTP(workEmail);\n\n    if (result.success) {\n      setStep('otp');\n    } else {\n      setError(result.error || 'Failed to send OTP');\n    }\n\n    setIsLoading(false);\n  };\n\n  const handleVerifyOTP = async (e: React.FormEvent)\n;\n}",

        "contents": "import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';\nimport { redirect } from 'next/navigation';\nimport { Suspense } from 'react';\n\n/**\n * Work email verification page\n * Users are redirected here after Google OAuth login to verify their work email\n */\nexport default async function Page() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  // If not authenticated, redirect to login\n  if (!user) {\n    redirect('/auth/login');\n  }\n\n  // Check if profile is already linked\n  const { data: profile } = await supabase\n    .from('profiles')\n    .select('id, removed_access')\n    .eq('user_id', user.id)\n    .single();\n\n  // If profile is linked and access is active, redirect to protected area\n  if (profile &amp;&amp; !profile.removed_access) {\n    redirect('/protected');\n  }\n\n  // If access is revoked, redirect to access revoked page\n  if (profile &amp;&amp; profile.removed_access) {\n    redirect('/auth/access-revoked');\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"flex min-h-svh w-full items-center justify-center p-6 md:p-10\"&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"w-full max-w-sm\"&gt;\n        &lt;Suspense fallback={&lt;div&gt;Loading...&lt;/div&gt;}&gt;\n          &lt;WorkEmailForm /&gt;\n        &lt;/Suspense&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  );\n}\n\nexport const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';",

        },
        "contents": "export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n\n\n  // If no user and not a public route, redirect to login\n  if (!user &amp;&amp; !isPublicRoute) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/login\";\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n\n  // If user is authenticated, check profile linking and access status\n  // Skip this check for admin routes (they handle their own auth in layout)\n  if (user &amp;&amp; !isPublicRoute &amp;&amp; !isAdminRoute) {\n    const { data: profile } = await supabase\n      .from('profiles')\n      .select('id, removed_access')\n      .eq('user_id', user.sub)\n      .single();\n\n    // If no profile linked, redirect to work email verification\n    if (!profile) {\n      const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n      url.pathname = \"/auth/verify-work-email\";\n      return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n    }\n\n    // If access is revoked, redirect to access revoked page\n    if (profile.removed_access) {\n      const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n      url.pathname = \"/auth/access-revoked\";\n      return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n    }\n  }\n  \n  // Admin routes: check admin role in middleware\n  if (user &amp;&amp; isAdminRoute) {\n    const { data: profile } = await supabase\n      .from('profiles')\n      .select('id, role, removed_access')\n      .eq('user_id', user.sub)\n      .single();\n\n    // If no profile or not admin, redirect\n    if (!profile || profile.role !== 'admin' || profile.removed_access) {\n      const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n      url.pathname = \"/protected\";\n      return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n    }\n  }\n\n  // IMPORTANT: You *must* return the supabaseResponse object as it is.\n  // If you're creating a new response object with NextResponse.next() make sure to:\n  // 1. Pass the request in it, like so:\n  //    const myNewResponse = NextResponse.next({ request })\n  // 2. Copy over the cookies, like so:\n  //    myNewResponse.cookies.setAll(supabaseResponse.cookies.getAll())\n  // 3. Change the myNewResponse object to fit your needs, but avoid changing\n  //    the cookies!\n  // 4. Finally:\n  //    return myNewResponse\n  // If this is not done, you may be causing the browser and server to go out\n  // of sync and terminate the user's session prematurely!\n\n  return supabaseResponse;\n}",

        "contents": "import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\nimport { hasEnvVars } from \"../utils\";\n\nexport async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  // If the env vars are not set, skip proxy check. You can remove this\n  // once you setup the project.\n  if (!hasEnvVars) {\n    return supabaseResponse;\n  }\n\n  // With Fluid compute, don't put this client in a global environment\n  // variable. Always create a new one on each request.\n  const supabase = createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return request.cookies.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt;\n            request.cookies.set(name, value),\n          );\n          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n            request,\n          });\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt;\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options),\n          );\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n\n  // Do not run code between createServerClient and\n  // supabase.auth.getClaims(). A simple mistake could make it very hard to debug\n  // issues with users being randomly logged out.\n\n  // IMPORTANT: If you remove getClaims() and you use server-side rendering\n  // with the Supabase client, your users may be randomly logged out.\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n  const user = data?.claims;\n\n  // Public routes that don't require authentication\n  const publicRoutes = ['/', '/auth/login', '/auth/error', '/auth/pending-approval', '/auth/access-revoked', '/auth/verify-work-email', '/auth/callback'];\n  const isPublicRoute = publicRoutes.includes(request.nextUrl.pathname) || \n    request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith('/auth/');\n  \n  // Admin routes require admin role check (handled in admin layout)\n  const isAdminRoute = request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith('/admin/');\n\n  // If no user and not a public route, redirect to login\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Verifies OTP code and links profile to authenticated user\n * @param workEmail - The work email address that received the OTP\n * @param otpCode - The OTP code entered by the user\n * @returns Object with success status and optional error message\n */\nexport async function verifyWorkEmailOTP(workEmail: string, otpCode: string) {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n\n  // Verify OTP\n  const { error: verifyError } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n    email: workEmail,\n    token: otpCode,\n    type: 'email',\n  });\n\n  if (verifyError) {\n    return {\n      success: false,\n      error: verifyError.message,\n    };\n  }\n\n  // Get current authenticated user\n  const { data: { user }, error: userError } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (userError || !user) {\n    return {\n      success: false,\n      error: 'Failed to get authenticated user',\n    };\n  }\n\n  // Check if profile exists for this work email\n  const { data: profile, error: profileError } = await supabase\n    .from('profiles')\n    .select('id, user_id')\n    .eq('work_email', workEmail.toLowerCase())\n    .single();\n\n  if (profileError || !profile) {\n    // No profile exists - user needs admin approval\n    redirect('/auth/pending-approval');\n  }\n\n  // Check if profile is already linked to another user\n  if (profile.user_id &amp;&amp; profile.user_id !== user.id) {\n    return {\n      success: false,\n      error: 'This work email is already linked to another account',\n    };\n  }\n\n  // Link profile to current user\n  const { error: updateError } = await supabase\n    .from('profiles')\n    .update({\n      user_id: user.id,\n      picture: user.user_metadata?.avatar_url || null,\n      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),\n    })\n    .eq('work_email', workEmail.toLowerCase());\n\n  if (updateError) {\n    return {\n      success: false,\n      error: updateError.message,\n    };\n  }\n\n  revalidatePath('/');\n  redirect('/protected');\n}\n\n/**\n * Revokes access for a user profile\n * @param profileId - The ID of the profile to revoke access for\n * @returns Object with success status and optional error message\n */",

        "contents": "'use server';\n\nimport { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';\nimport { isValidWorkEmailDomain } from '@/lib/constants/auth';\nimport { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache';\nimport { redirect } from 'next/navigation';\n\n/**\n * Sends an OTP to the provided work email for verification\n * @param workEmail - The work email address to send OTP to\n * @returns Object with success status and optional error message\n */\nexport async function sendWorkEmailOTP(workEmail: string) {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n\n  // Validate domain before sending OTP\n  if (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(workEmail)) {\n    return {\n      success: false,\n      error: 'Email must be @studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz',\n    };\n  }\n\n  // Send OTP to work email (shouldCreateUser: false prevents new user creation)\n  const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({\n    email: workEmail,\n    options: {\n      shouldCreateUser: false,\n    },\n  });\n\n  if (error) {\n    return {\n      success: false,\n      error: error.message,\n    };\n  }\n\n  return {\n    success: true,\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * Verifies OTP code and links profile to authenticated user\n * @param workEmail - The work email address that received the OTP\n * @param otpCode - The OTP code entered by the user\n * @returns Object with success status and optional error message\n */",

        "contents": "1. **RLS Policies** (row-level access control):\n\n   - Users can only read/update their own profile (limited fields)\n   - Only admins can create/delete profiles and manage teams\n   - Team data viewable by team members\n\n2. **Database Constraints**:\n\n   - Domain constraint ensures only valid CZU domains in profiles\n   - Unique constraints on work_email, user_id\n\n### Next.js (Application Layer)\n\n1. **Middleware Verification**:\n\n   - Queries &#96;profiles&#96; table for linked user_id\n   - Checks &#96;removed_access&#96; is null for active access\n   - Enforces role-based route protection\n   - Real-time verification (instant access revocation)\n\n2. **Domain Validation** (in server actions):\n\n   - Client-side validation for UX (immediate feedback)\n   - Server-side validation before sending OTP\n   - Validates email format and CZU domain\n\n3. **Access Management** (in server actions):\n\n   - Admin sets &#96;removed_access&#96; timestamp and &#96;removed_access_by&#96; profile\n   - Immediate effect on next request\n   - Audit trail of who revoked access and when\n\n## Authentication Flow Details\n\n### Step 1: Google Login\n\nUser clicks Google login button, Supabase handles OAuth flow.\n\n### Step 2: Work Email Input with Domain Validation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Validate domain before sending OTP\nif (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(workEmail)) {\n  throw new Error('Email must be @studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz');\n}\n\n// Send OTP to work email (only after domain validation passes)\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  options: { shouldCreateUser: false }\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 3: OTP Verification and Profile Linking\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// After user enters OTP, verify it\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  token: otpCode,\n  type: 'email'\n});\n\n// Check if profile exists for this work email\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .select('id')\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) {\n  // No profile exists - redirect to pending approval",

        "contents": "import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';\nimport Link from 'next/link';\nimport { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';\nimport { AuthButton } from '@/components/auth-button';\nimport { Suspense } from 'react';\n\n/**\n * Admin layout with role-based access control\n * Only admins can access admin routes\n */\nexport default async function AdminLayout({\n  children,\n}: {\n  children: React.ReactNode;\n}) {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (!user) {\n    redirect('/auth/login');\n  }\n\n  // Check if user is admin\n  const { data: profile } = await supabase\n    .from('profiles')\n    .select('id, role')\n    .eq('user_id', user.id)\n    .eq('role', 'admin')\n    .is('removed_access', null)\n    .single();\n\n  if (!profile) {\n    redirect('/protected');\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;main className=\"min-h-screen flex flex-col\"&gt;\n      &lt;nav className=\"w-full flex justify-center border-b border-b-foreground/10 h-16\"&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"w-full max-w-7xl flex justify-between items-center p-3 px-5 text-sm\"&gt;\n          &lt;div className=\"flex gap-5 items-center font-semibold\"&gt;\n            &lt;Link href=\"/protected\"&gt;Home&lt;/Link&gt;\n            &lt;Link href=\"/admin/users\"&gt;Users&lt;/Link&gt;\n            &lt;Link href=\"/admin/profiles\"&gt;Profiles&lt;/Link&gt;\n            &lt;Link href=\"/admin/teams\"&gt;Teams&lt;/Link&gt;\n          &lt;/div&gt;\n          &lt;Suspense&gt;\n            &lt;AuthButton /&gt;\n          &lt;/Suspense&gt;\n        &lt;/div&gt;\n      &lt;/nav&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"flex-1 container mx-auto p-6\"&gt;\n        {children}\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    &lt;/main&gt;\n  );\n}",

The root `/` is a public route, so the middleware doesn't check for profile linking. Updating the middleware to check authenticated users on `/` and redirect unverified users:


---

<tool-use data-tool-type="write" data-tool-name="edit_file_v2">

<details><summary>Tool use: **edit_file_v2** • Edit file: /Users/tom/programming/tappka/lib/supabase/proxy.ts</summary>

</details>

</tool-use>

---


## Changes Made:

1. **Created OAuth callback handler** (`/app/auth/callback/route.ts`):
   - Handles Google OAuth redirects
   - Exchanges the code for a session
   - Checks profile linking and redirects accordingly

2. **Updated Google login button**:
   - Changed `redirectTo` to `/auth/callback` instead of `/auth/verify-work-email`
   - The callback handler manages the redirect logic

3. **Fixed middleware logic**:
   - Previously, `/` was treated as a public route, so authenticated users weren't checked for profile linking
   - Now checks profile linking on all routes except auth-only routes
   - When a user logs in with Google and lands on `/`, the middleware detects no profile and redirects to `/auth/verify-work-email`

4. **Updated Supabase config**:
   - Added callback URLs to `additional_redirect_urls`

## How it works now:

1. User clicks "Continue with Google"
2. Google OAuth completes
3. Supabase redirects to `/auth/callback` with a code
4. Callback handler exchanges code for session
5. Checks for profile linking
6. Redirects to `/auth/verify-work-email` if no profile is linked

If the callback route isn't hit (e.g., Supabase redirects to `/`), the middleware will catch it and redirect to `/auth/verify-work-email`.

Try logging in with Google again; it should redirect to the work email verification form.

        "contents": "import { type EmailOtpType } from \"@supabase/supabase-js\";\nimport { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\n\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);\n  const token_hash = searchParams.get(\"token_hash\");\n  const type = searchParams.get(\"type\") as EmailOtpType | null;\n  const next = searchParams.get(\"next\") ?? \"/\";\n\n  if (token_hash &amp;&amp; type) {\n    const supabase = await createClient();\n\n    const { error: verifyError } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n      type,\n      token_hash,\n    });\n    \n    if (verifyError) {\n      redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=${encodeURIComponent(verifyError.message)}&#96;);\n    }\n\n    // After OTP verification via email link, redirect to verification page\n    // The user will need to enter their work email again to complete linking\n    // This is because we can't reliably get the work email from token_hash verification\n    redirect('/auth/verify-work-email?verified=true');\n  }\n\n  // redirect the user to an error page with some instructions\n  redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=No token hash or type&#96;);\n}",

        "contents": "'use client';\n\nimport { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client';\nimport { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';\nimport { useState } from 'react';\nimport { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';\n\n/**\n * Google OAuth login button component\n * Initiates Google OAuth flow and redirects to work email verification after successful login\n */\nexport function GoogleLoginButton() {\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n  const router = useRouter();\n\n  const handleGoogleLogin = async () =&gt; {\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    const supabase = createClient();\n\n    try {\n      const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({\n        provider: 'google',\n        options: {\n          redirectTo: &#96;${window.location.origin}/auth/callback&#96;,\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (error) {\n        console.error('Google login error:', error);\n        router.push(&#96;/auth/error?error=${encodeURIComponent(error.message)}&#96;);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Unexpected error during Google login:', error);\n      router.push(&#96;/auth/error?error=${encodeURIComponent('An unexpected error occurred')}&#96;);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;Button\n      onClick={handleGoogleLogin}\n      disabled={isLoading}\n}",

          }
        },
        "contents": "/**\n * Verifies OTP code and links profile to authenticated user\n * @param workEmail - The work email address that received the OTP\n * @param otpCode - The OTP code entered by the user\n * @returns Object with success status and optional error message\n */\nexport async function verifyWorkEmailOTP(workEmail: string, otpCode: string) {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n\n  // Verify OTP\n  const { error: verifyError } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n    email: workEmail,\n    token: otpCode,\n    type: 'email',\n  });\n\n  if (verifyError) {\n    return {\n      success: false,\n      error: verifyError.message,\n    };\n  }\n\n  // Get current authenticated user\n  const { data: { user }, error: userError } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (userError || !user) {\n    return {\n      success: false,\n      error: 'Failed to get authenticated user',\n    };\n  }\n\n  // Check if profile exists for this work email\n  const { data: profile, error: profileError } = await supabase\n    .from('profiles')\n    .select('id, user_id')\n    .eq('work_email', workEmail.toLowerCase())\n    .single();\n\n  if (profileError || !profile) {\n    // No profile exists - user needs admin approval\n    redirect('/auth/pending-approval');\n  }\n\n  // Check if profile is already linked to another user\n  if (profile.user_id &amp;&amp; profile.user_id !== user.id) {\n    return {\n      success: false,\n      error: 'This work email is already linked to another account',\n    };\n  }\n\n  // Link profile to current user\n  const { error: updateError } = await supabase\n    .from('profiles')\n    .update({\n      user_id: user.id,\n      picture: user.user_metadata?.avatar_url || null,\n      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),\n    })\n    .eq('work_email', workEmail.toLowerCase());\n\n  if (updateError) {\n    return {\n      success: false,\n      error: updateError.message,\n    };\n  }\n\n  revalidatePath('/');\n  redirect('/protected');\n}\n\n/**\n * Revokes access for a user profile\n * @param profileId - The ID of the profile to revoke access for\n * @returns Object with success status and optional error message\n */",

        "contents": "import { cookies } from \"next/headers\";\n\n/**\n * Especially important if using Fluid compute: Don't put this client in a\n * global variable. Always create a new client within each function when using\n * it.\n */\nexport async function createClient() {\n  const cookieStore = await cookies();\n\n  return createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return cookieStore.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          try {\n            cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt;\n              cookieStore.set(name, value, options),\n            );\n          } catch {\n            // The &#96;setAll&#96; method was called from a Server Component.\n            // This can be ignored if you have proxy refreshing\n            // user sessions.\n          }\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n}",

        "contents": "export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n\n\n  // If no user and not a public route, redirect to login\n  if (!user &amp;&amp; !isPublicRoute) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/login\";\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n\n  // If user is authenticated, check profile linking and access status\n  // Check on all routes except auth-only routes and admin routes\n  if (user &amp;&amp; !isAuthOnlyRoute &amp;&amp; !isAdminRoute) {\n    const { data: profile } = await supabase\n      .from('profiles')\n      .select('id, removed_access')\n      .eq('user_id', user.sub)\n      .single();\n\n    // If no profile linked, redirect to work email verification\n    if (!profile) {\n      const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n      url.pathname = \"/auth/verify-work-email\";\n      return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n    }\n\n    // If access is revoked, redirect to access revoked page\n    if (profile.removed_access) {\n      const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n      url.pathname = \"/auth/access-revoked\";\n      return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n    }\n  }\n  \n  // Admin routes: check admin role in middleware\n  if (user &amp;&amp; isAdminRoute) {\n    const { data: profile } = await supabase\n      .from('profiles')\n      .select('id, role, removed_access')\n      .eq('user_id', user.sub)\n      .single();\n\n    // If no profile or not admin, redirect\n    if (!profile || profile.role !== 'admin' || profile.removed_access) {\n      const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n      url.pathname = \"/protected\";\n      return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n    }\n  }\n\n  // IMPORTANT: You *must* return the supabaseResponse object as it is.\n  // If you're creating a new response object with NextResponse.next() make sure to:\n  // 1. Pass the request in it, like so:\n  //    const myNewResponse = NextResponse.next({ request })\n  // 2. Copy over the cookies, like so:\n  //    myNewResponse.cookies.setAll(supabaseResponse.cookies.getAll())\n  // 3. Change the myNewResponse object to fit your needs, but avoid changing\n  //    the cookies!\n  // 4. Finally:\n  //    return myNewResponse\n  // If this is not done, you may be causing the browser and server to go out\n  // of sync and terminate the user's session prematurely!\n\n  return supabaseResponse;\n}",

        "contents": "import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';\nimport { redirect } from 'next/navigation';\nimport { Suspense } from 'react';\n\n/**\n * Work email verification page\n * Users are redirected here after Google OAuth login to verify their work email\n */\nexport default async function Page() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  // If not authenticated, redirect to login\n  if (!user) {\n    redirect('/auth/login');\n  }\n\n  // Check if profile is already linked\n  const { data: profile } = await supabase\n    .from('profiles')\n    .select('id, removed_access')\n    .eq('user_id', user.id)\n    .single();\n\n  // If profile is linked and access is active, redirect to protected area\n  if (profile &amp;&amp; !profile.removed_access) {\n    redirect('/protected');\n  }\n\n  // If access is revoked, redirect to access revoked page\n  if (profile &amp;&amp; profile.removed_access) {\n    redirect('/auth/access-revoked');\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"flex min-h-svh w-full items-center justify-center p-6 md:p-10\"&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"w-full max-w-sm\"&gt;\n        &lt;Suspense fallback={&lt;div&gt;Loading...&lt;/div&gt;}&gt;\n          &lt;WorkEmailForm /&gt;\n        &lt;/Suspense&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  );\n}\n\nexport const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';",

          }

        "contents": "1. **RLS Policies** (row-level access control):\n\n   - Users can only read/update their own profile (limited fields)\n   - Only admins can create/delete profiles and manage teams\n   - Team data viewable by team members\n\n2. **Database Constraints**:\n\n   - Domain constraint ensures only valid CZU domains in profiles\n   - Unique constraints on work_email, user_id\n\n### Next.js (Application Layer)\n\n1. **Middleware Verification**:\n\n   - Queries &#96;profiles&#96; table for linked user_id\n   - Checks &#96;removed_access&#96; is null for active access\n   - Enforces role-based route protection\n   - Real-time verification (instant access revocation)\n\n2. **Domain Validation** (in server actions):\n\n   - Client-side validation for UX (immediate feedback)\n   - Server-side validation before sending OTP\n   - Validates email format and CZU domain\n\n3. **Access Management** (in server actions):\n\n   - Admin sets &#96;removed_access&#96; timestamp and &#96;removed_access_by&#96; profile\n   - Immediate effect on next request\n   - Audit trail of who revoked access and when\n\n## Authentication Flow Details\n\n### Step 1: Google Login\n\nUser clicks Google login button, Supabase handles OAuth flow.\n\n### Step 2: Work Email Input with Domain Validation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Validate domain before sending OTP\nif (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(workEmail)) {\n  throw new Error('Email must be @studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz');\n}\n\n// Send OTP to work email (only after domain validation passes)\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  options: { shouldCreateUser: false }\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 3: OTP Verification and Profile Linking\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// After user enters OTP, verify it\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  token: otpCode,\n  type: 'email'\n});\n\n// Check if profile exists for this work email\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .select('id')\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) {\n  // No profile exists - redirect to pending approval",

            "lineNumber": 374
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Domain Validation** (in server actions):",
            "lineNumber": 375
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 376
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Client-side validation for UX (immediate feedback)",
            "lineNumber": 377
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Server-side validation before sending OTP",
            "lineNumber": 378
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Validates email format and CZU domain",
            "lineNumber": 379
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 380
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **Access Management** (in server actions):",
            "lineNumber": 381
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 382
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Admin sets &#96;removed_access&#96; timestamp and &#96;removed_access_by&#96; profile",

          },
          {
            "text": "   - Immediate effect on next request",
            "lineNumber": 384
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Audit trail of who revoked access and when",
            "lineNumber": 385
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 386
          },
          {
            "text": "## Authentication Flow Details",
            "lineNumber": 387
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 388
          },
          {
            "text": "### Step 1: Google Login",
            "lineNumber": 389
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 390
          },
          {
            "text": "User clicks Google login button, Supabase handles OAuth flow.",
            "lineNumber": 391
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 392
          },
          {
            "text": "### Step 2: Work Email Input with Domain Validation",

          {
            "lineNumber": 394
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",
            "lineNumber": 395
          },

            "text": "// Validate domain before sending OTP",

            "lineNumber": 397
          },

            "lineNumber": 399
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 400

          },
          {
            "text": "  email: workEmail,",
            "lineNumber": 403
          },
          {
            "text": "  options: { shouldCreateUser: false }",
            "lineNumber": 404
          },
          {
            "text": "});",
            "lineNumber": 405
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 406
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 407
          },
          {
            "text": "### Step 3: OTP Verification and Profile Linking",
            "lineNumber": 408
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 409
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",
            "lineNumber": 410
          },
          {
            "text": "// After user enters OTP, verify it",
            "lineNumber": 411
          },
          {
            "text": "const { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({",
            "lineNumber": 412
          },
          {
            "text": "  email: workEmail,",
            "lineNumber": 413
          },
          {
            "text": "  token: otpCode,",
            "lineNumber": 414
          },
          {
            "text": "  type: 'email'",
            "lineNumber": 415
          },
          {
            "text": "});",
            "lineNumber": 416
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 417
          },
          {
            "text": "// Check if profile exists for this work email",
            "lineNumber": 418
          },
          {
            "text": "const { data: profile } = await supabase",

          },

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 423
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 424
          },
          {

          },
          {

          }

        "contents": "// scripts/setup-env.js\nimport { execSync } from 'child_process';\nimport fs from 'fs';\nimport path from 'path';\nimport { fileURLToPath } from 'url';\nimport { dirname } from 'path';\n\nconst __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);\nconst __dirname = dirname(__filename);\n\n// Key mapping from supabase status to Next.js env vars\nconst keyMapping = {\n  API_URL: 'NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL',\n  ANON_KEY: 'NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY',\n  PUBLISHABLE_KEY: 'NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY',\n  SERVICE_ROLE_KEY: 'SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY',\n};\n\n/**\n * Parses environment variables from a string content\n * Handles both KEY=value and KEY=\"value\" formats\n * @param content - The content string to parse\n * @returns Object mapping keys to values\n */\nconst parseEnvContent = (content) =&gt; {\n  const envVars = {};\n  for (const line of content.split('\\n')) {\n    const trimmed = line.trim();\n    if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith('#')) {\n      continue;\n    }\n    const match = trimmed.match(/^([^=]+)=(.*)$/);\n    if (match) {\n      const key = match[1].trim();\n      let value = match[2].trim();\n      // Remove quotes if present\n      if ((value.startsWith('\"') &amp;&amp; value.endsWith('\"')) || \n          (value.startsWith(\"'\") &amp;&amp; value.endsWith(\"'\"))) {\n        value = value.slice(1, -1);\n      }\n      envVars[key] = value;\n    }\n  }\n  return envVars;\n};\n\n/**\n * Formats environment variables back to .env file format\n * @param envVars - Object mapping keys to values\n * @returns Formatted string content\n */",

        "contents": "// Run supabase status and parse output\nconst output = execSync('pnpm supabase status -o env', { encoding: 'utf-8' });\nconst newEnvVars = {};\n\nfor (const line of output.split('\\n')) {\n  const match = line.match(/^(\\w+)=\"(.+)\"$/);\n  if (match &amp;&amp; keyMapping[match[1]]) {\n    newEnvVars[keyMapping[match[1]]] = match[2];\n  }\n}\n\n// Read existing .env.local if it exists\nconst envLocalPath = path.join(__dirname, '..', '.env.local');\nlet existingEnvVars = {};\n\nif (fs.existsSync(envLocalPath)) {\n  const existingContent = fs.readFileSync(envLocalPath, 'utf-8');\n  existingEnvVars = parseEnvContent(existingContent);\n}\n\n// Merge: update existing vars with new values, keep others unchanged\nconst mergedEnvVars = {\n  ...existingEnvVars,\n  ...newEnvVars,\n};\n\n// Write merged content to .env.local\nconst envContent = formatEnvContent(mergedEnvVars);\nfs.writeFileSync(envLocalPath, envContent + '\\n');\nconsole.log('Environment variables updated in .env.local');",

        "contents": "│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘│\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n                           │\n                           ▼\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                        Supabase                                  │\n│  ┌─────────────────────┐  ┌─────────────────────────────────┐   │\n│  │   Auth Service      │  │         PostgreSQL              │   │\n│  │  - Google OAuth     │  │  - profiles table               │   │\n│  │  - OTP emails       │  │  - teams table                  │   │\n│  │  - Session mgmt     │  │  - RLS policies (access ctrl)   │   │\n│  └─────────────────────┘  └─────────────────────────────────┘   │\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n\n## Simplicity Principles\n\n1. **No tRPC for auth** - Use Supabase client directly (fewer layers)\n2. **Business logic in Next.js** - Server actions and middleware handle all rules\n3. **Supabase for storage only** - No hooks, no custom functions, just tables + RLS\n4. **Minimal components** - Reuse shadcn/ui, no custom abstractions\n5. **Direct database queries** - Query profiles table for verification and access status\n6. **Admin-first onboarding** - Admin creates profiles, users link via work email verification",

          "endPosition": {

        "contents": "file_size_limit = \"50MiB\"\n\n# Uncomment to configure local storage buckets\n# [storage.buckets.images]\n# public = false\n# file_size_limit = \"50MiB\"\n# allowed_mime_types = [\"image/png\", \"image/jpeg\"]\n# objects_path = \"./images\"\n\n# Allow connections via S3 compatible clients\n[storage.s3_protocol]\nenabled = true\n\n# Image transformation API is available to Supabase Pro plan.\n# [storage.image_transformation]\n# enabled = true\n\n# Store analytical data in S3 for running ETL jobs over Iceberg Catalog\n# This feature is only available on the hosted platform.\n[storage.analytics]\nenabled = false\nmax_namespaces = 5\nmax_tables = 10\nmax_catalogs = 2\n\n# Analytics Buckets is available to Supabase Pro plan.\n# [storage.analytics.buckets.my-warehouse]\n\n# Store vector embeddings in S3 for large and durable datasets\n# This feature is only available on the hosted platform.\n[storage.vector]\nenabled = false\nmax_buckets = 10\nmax_indexes = 5\n\n# Vector Buckets is available to Supabase Pro plan.\n# [storage.vector.buckets.documents-openai]\n\n[auth]\nenabled = true\n# The base URL of your website. Used as an allow-list for redirects and for constructing URLs used\n# in emails.\nsite_url = \"http://127.0.0.1:3000\"\n# A list of *exact* URLs that auth providers are permitted to redirect to post authentication.\nadditional_redirect_urls = [\n  \"https://127.0.0.1:3000\",\n  \"http://127.0.0.1:3000/auth/callback\",\n  \"http://127.0.0.1:3000/auth/verify-work-email\"\n]\n# How long tokens are valid for, in seconds. Defaults to 3600 (1 hour), maximum 604,800 (1 week).\njwt_expiry = 3600\n# JWT issuer URL. If not set, defaults to the local API URL (http://127.0.0.1:&lt;port&gt;/auth/v1).\n# jwt_issuer = \"\"\n# Path to JWT signing key.         "contents": "if (!profile) {\n  // No profile exists - redirect to pending approval\n  redirect('/auth/pending-approval');\n}\n\n// Link profile to current user\nconst { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\nawait supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .update({ \n    user_id: user.id,\n    picture: user.user_metadata.avatar_url  // Default to Google picture\n  })\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 4: Middleware Validation\n\nQuery database for profile linked to current auth.user and check &#96;removed_access IS NULL&#96; on every request to protected routes.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Middleware check\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .select('id, role, removed_access')\n  .eq('user_id', user.id)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) redirect('/auth/verify-work-email');\nif (profile.removed_access) redirect('/auth/access-revoked');\n// User has active access, continue...\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Estimated Complexity\n\n| Task | Complexity | Lines of Code |\n\n|------|------------|---------------|\n\n| Delete old auth files | Trivial | -500 lines |\n\n| Security lockdown config | Trivial | ~20 lines TOML |\n\n| Database migration | Low | ~50 lines SQL (profiles, teams, indexes) |\n\n| Constants + validation | Trivial | ~25 lines |\n\n| Server actions (business logic) | Medium | ~80 lines |\n\n| Middleware update | Medium | ~50 lines (includes DB queries) |\n\n| Google login page | Low | ~30 lines |\n\n| Work email form + linking | Medium | ~120 lines |\n\n| Admin UI (profiles + teams) | Medium | ~150 lines |\n\n**Total new code**: ~525 lines (vs ~500 lines deleted)\n\n## Separation of Concerns\n\n### Supabase (Auth + Storage Only)\n\n- **Authentication**: Google OAuth flow, session management, OTP emails\n- **Database**: Store profiles, teams data with RLS for row-level access control\n- **No business logic**: No custom hooks, no stored procedures, no triggers for business rules\n\n### Next.js (All Business Logic)\n\n- **Middleware**: Profile verification, access checks, role-based routing\n- **Server Actions**: Profile linking, access revocation, team management\n- **Validation**: Domain validation, input sanitization, business rules",

## Changes Made:

1. **Updated middleware** (`lib/supabase/proxy.ts`):
   - After exchanging the OAuth code for a session, checks if the user has a linked profile
   - Redirects based on profile status:
     - `/protected` if profile exists and is active
     - `/auth/access-revoked` if access is revoked
     - `/auth/verify-work-email` if no profile is linked

2. **Login page** (`app/auth/login/page.tsx`):
   - Also handles code exchange as a fallback
   - Redirects appropriately if the middleware doesn't catch it

## How it works now:

1. User clicks "Continue with Google"
2. Google OAuth completes and redirects to `/auth/login?code=...`
3. Middleware intercepts the request:
   - Exchanges code for session
   - Checks for profile linking
   - Redirects to `/auth/verify-work-email` if no profile
4. User sees the work email verification form

Try logging in with Google again. After authentication, you should be redirected to `/auth/verify-work-email` to enter your work email.

Fixed the PKCE issue. The code verifier is stored in browser storage, but we were exchanging the code server-side. Changes:

## Changes Made:

1. **Created client-side callback page** (`/app/auth/callback/page.tsx`):
   - Handles OAuth code exchange client-side (has access to PKCE code verifier)
   - Checks profile linking and redirects accordingly
   - Shows a loading spinner during the process

2. **Removed server-side code exchange** from middleware:
   - Removed the code exchange logic that was causing the PKCE error
   - Middleware now allows the callback page to load without interference

3. **Simplified login page**:
   - Removed server-side code handling (now handled by callback page)

4. **Deleted server-side callback route**:
   - Replaced with client-side page component

## How it works now:

1. User clicks "Continue with Google"
2. Google OAuth redirects to `/auth/callback?code=...`
3. Client-side callback page:
   - Exchanges code for session (PKCE works because code verifier is in browser storage)
   - Checks for profile linking
   - Redirects to `/auth/verify-work-email` if no profile
4. User sees the work email verification form

The PKCE error should be resolved. Try logging in with Google again; it should redirect to the work email verification form.

Yes, we're using Supabase SSR. Here's what's set up:

## Supabase SSR Setup

1. Package: `@supabase/ssr` (latest) in `package.json`

2. Server-side client (`lib/supabase/server.ts`):
   - Uses `createServerClient` from `@supabase/ssr`
   - Manages cookies via Next.js `cookies()` API
   - Used in Server Components and Server Actions

3. Client-side client (`lib/supabase/client.ts`):
   - Uses `createBrowserClient` from `@supabase/ssr`
   - Used in Client Components

4. Middleware (`lib/supabase/proxy.ts`):
   - Uses `createServerClient` for session management
   - Refreshes sessions on each request
   - Handles cookie management in middleware

## Why this matters for OAuth

With Supabase SSR and PKCE:
- The code verifier is stored in browser storage (localStorage/sessionStorage)
- Code exchange must happen client-side to access the verifier
- That's why the callback page is client-side (`'use client'`)

The current setup is correct for Next.js App Router with Supabase SSR. The PKCE error was caused by trying to exchange the code server-side; moving it to the client-side callback page resolves it.

{\n    const handleCallback = async () =&gt; {\n      if (!code) {\n        router.push('/auth/login');\n        return;\n      }\n\n      const supabase = createClient();\n      \n      // Exchange code for session (client-side handles PKCE automatically)\n      const { error } = await supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code);\n      \n      if (error) {\n        console.error('OAuth callback error:', error);\n        router.push(&#96;/auth/error?error=${encodeURIComponent(error.message)}&#96;);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Check if user has a linked profile\n      const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n      \n      if (user) {\n        const { data: profile } = await supabase\n          .from('profiles')\n          .select('id, removed_access')\n          .eq('user_id', user.id)\n          .single();\n\n        // If profile is linked and active, redirect to protected area\n        if (profile &amp;&amp;         "contents": "'use client';\n\nimport { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client';\nimport { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';\nimport { useState } from 'react';\nimport { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';\n\n/**\n * Google OAuth login button component\n * Initiates Google OAuth flow and redirects to work email verification after successful login\n */\nexport function GoogleLoginButton() {\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n  const router = useRouter();\n\n  const handleGoogleLogin = async () =&gt; {\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    const supabase = createClient();\n\n    try {\n      const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({\n        provider: 'google',\n        options: {\n          redirectTo: &#96;${window.location.origin}/auth/callback&#96;,\n        },\n      });\n\n      // If there's a URL, Supabase will redirect automatically\n      // No need to handle error here as redirect will happen\n\n      if (error) {\n        console.error('Google login error:', error);\n        router.push(&#96;/auth/error?error=${encodeURIComponent(error.message)}&#96;);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Unexpected error during Google login:', error);\n      router.push(&#96;/auth/error?error=${encodeURIComponent('An unexpected error occurred')}&#96;);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;Button\n      onClick={handleGoogleLogin}\n      disabled={isLoading}\n}",

        "contents": "export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\nconst authOnlyRoutes = [ '/auth/callback'];\n  const isAuthOnlyRoute = authOnlyRoutes.includes(request.nextUrl.pathname);\n  const isPublicRoute = isAuthOnlyRoute || request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith('/auth/');\n  \n  // Allow callback page to load (it handles code exchange client-side)\n  if (request.nextUrl.pathname === '/auth/callback') {\n    return supabaseResponse;\n  }\n  \n  // Admin routes require admin role check (handled in admin layout)\n  const isAdminRoute = request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith('/admin/');\n\n  // If no user and not a public route, redirect to login\n  if (!user &amp;&amp; !isPublicRoute) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/login\";\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n\n  // If user is authenticated, check profile linking and access status\n  // Check on all routes except auth-only routes and admin routes\n  if (user &amp;&amp; !isAuthOnlyRoute &amp;&amp; !isAdminRoute) {\n    const { data: profile } = await supabase\n      .from('profiles')\n      .select('id, removed_access')\n      .eq('user_id', user.sub)\n      .single();\n\n    // If no profile linked, redirect to work email verification\n    if (!profile) {\n      const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n      url.pathname = \"/auth/verify-work-email\";\n      return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n    }\n\n    // If access is revoked, redirect to access revoked page\n    if (profile.removed_access) {\n      const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n      url.pathname = \"/auth/access-revoked\";\n      return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n    }\n  }\n  \n  // Admin routes: check admin role in middleware\n  if (user &amp;&amp; isAdminRoute) {\n    const { data: profile } = await supabase\n      .from('profiles')\n      .select('id, role, removed_access')\n      .eq('user_id', user.sub)\n      .single();\n\n    // If no profile or not admin, redirect\n    if (!profile || profile.role !== 'admin' || profile.removed_access) {\n      const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n      url.pathname = \"/protected\";\n      return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n    }\n  }\n\n  // IMPORTANT: You *must* return the supabaseResponse object as it is.\n}",

        "contents": "'use server';\n\nimport { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';\nimport { isValidWorkEmailDomain } from '@/lib/constants/auth';\nimport { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache';\nimport { redirect } from 'next/navigation';\n\n/**\n * Sends an OTP to the provided work email for verification\n * @param workEmail - The work email address to send OTP to\n * @returns Object with success status and optional error message\n */\nexport async function sendWorkEmailOTP(workEmail: string) {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n\n  // Validate domain before sending OTP\n  if (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(workEmail)) {\n    return {\n      success: false,\n      error: 'Email must be @studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz',\n    };\n  }\n\n  // Send OTP to work email (shouldCreateUser: false prevents new user creation)\n  const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({\n    email: workEmail,\n    options: {\n      shouldCreateUser: false,\n    },\n  });\n\n  if (error) {\n    return {\n      success: false,\n      error: error.message,\n    };\n  }\n\n  return {\n    success: true,\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * Verifies OTP code and links profile to authenticated user\n * @param workEmail - The work email address that received the OTP\n * @param otpCode - The OTP code entered by the user\n * @returns Object with success status and optional error message\n */",

        "contents": "skip_nonce_check = false\n# If enabled, it will allow the user to successfully authenticate when the provider does not return an email address.\nemail_optional = false\n\n[auth.external.google]\nenabled = true\nclient_id = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\"\nsecret = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\"\nredirect_uri = \"\"\nurl = \"\"\nskip_nonce_check = false\nemail_optional = false\n\n# Allow Solana wallet holders to sign in to your project via the Sign in with Solana (SIWS, EIP-4361) standard.\n# You can configure \"web3\" rate limit in the [auth.rate_limit] section and set up [auth.captcha] if self-hosting.\n[auth.web3.solana]\nenabled = false\n\n# Use Firebase Auth as a third-party provider alongside Supabase Auth.\n[auth.third_party.firebase]\nenabled = false\n# project_id = \"my-firebase-project\"\n\n# Use Auth0 as a third-party provider alongside Supabase Auth.\n[auth.third_party.auth0]\nenabled = false\n# tenant = \"my-auth0-tenant\"\n# tenant_region = \"us\"\n\n# Use AWS Cognito (Amplify) as a third-party provider alongside Supabase Auth.\n[auth.third_party.aws_cognito]\nenabled = false\n# user_pool_id = \"my-user-pool-id\"\n# user_pool_region = \"us-east-1\"\n\n# Use Clerk as a third-party provider alongside Supabase Auth.\n[auth.third_party.clerk]\nenabled = false\n# Obtain from https://clerk.com/setup/supabase\n# domain = \"example.clerk.accounts.dev\"\n\n# OAuth server configuration\n[auth.oauth_server]\n# Enable OAuth server functionality\nenabled = false\n# Path for OAuth consent flow UI\nauthorization_url_path = \"/oauth/consent\"\n# Allow dynamic client registration\nallow_dynamic_registration = false\n\n[edge_runtime]\nenabled = true\n# Supported request policies: &#96;oneshot&#96;, &#96;per_worker&#96;.\n# &#96;per_worker&#96;         "contents": "import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';\nimport { redirect } from 'next/navigation';\nimport { Suspense } from 'react';\n\n/**\n * Work email verification page\n * Users are redirected here after Google OAuth login to verify their work email\n */\nexport default async function Page() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  // If not authenticated, redirect to login\n  if (!user) {\n    redirect('/auth/login');\n  }\n\n  // Check if profile is already linked\n  const { data: profile } = await supabase\n    .from('profiles')\n    .select('id, removed_access')\n    .eq('user_id', user.id)\n    .single();\n\n  // If profile is linked and access is active, redirect to protected area\n  if (profile &amp;&amp; !profile.removed_access) {\n    redirect('/protected');\n  }\n\n  // If access is revoked, redirect to access revoked page\n  if (profile &amp;&amp; profile.removed_access) {\n    redirect('/auth/access-revoked');\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"flex min-h-svh w-full items-center justify-center p-6 md:p-10\"&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"w-full max-w-sm\"&gt;\n        &lt;Suspense fallback={&lt;div&gt;Loading...&lt;/div&gt;}&gt;\n          &lt;WorkEmailForm /&gt;\n        &lt;/Suspense&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  );\n}\n\nexport const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';",

        "contents": "import { type EmailOtpType } from \"@supabase/supabase-js\";\nimport { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\n\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);\n  const token_hash = searchParams.get(\"token_hash\");\n  const type = searchParams.get(\"type\") as EmailOtpType | null;\n  const next = searchParams.get(\"next\") ?? \"/\";\n\n  if (token_hash &amp;&amp; type) {\n    const supabase = await createClient();\n\n    const { error: verifyError } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n      type,\n      token_hash,\n    });\n    \n    if (verifyError) {\n      redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=${encodeURIComponent(verifyError.message)}&#96;);\n    }\n\n    // After OTP verification via email link, redirect to verification page\n    // The user will need to enter their work email again to complete linking\n    // This is because we can't reliably get the work email from token_hash verification\n    redirect('/auth/verify-work-email?verified=true');\n  }\n\n  // redirect the user to an error page with some instructions\n  redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=No token hash or type&#96;);\n}",

        "contents": "file_size_limit = \"50MiB\"\n\n# Uncomment to configure local storage buckets\n# [storage.buckets.images]\n# public = false\n# file_size_limit = \"50MiB\"\n# allowed_mime_types = [\"image/png\", \"image/jpeg\"]\n# objects_path = \"./images\"\n\n# Allow connections via S3 compatible clients\n[storage.s3_protocol]\nenabled = true\n\n# Image transformation API is available to Supabase Pro plan.\n# [storage.image_transformation]\n# enabled = true\n\n# Store analytical data in S3 for running ETL jobs over Iceberg Catalog\n# This feature is only available on the hosted platform.\n[storage.analytics]\nenabled = false\nmax_namespaces = 5\nmax_tables = 10\nmax_catalogs = 2\n\n# Analytics Buckets is available to Supabase Pro plan.\n# [storage.analytics.buckets.my-warehouse]\n\n# Store vector embeddings in S3 for large and durable datasets\n# This feature is only available on the hosted platform.\n[storage.vector]\nenabled = false\nmax_buckets = 10\nmax_indexes = 5\n\n# Vector Buckets is available to Supabase Pro plan.\n# [storage.vector.buckets.documents-openai]\n\n[auth]\nenabled = true\n# The base URL of your website.
